reviews.author: Robbie
reviews.review_text: This the worst company I have ever dealt with. You can never talk with a real person, everything is automated. They don't take your car payment on time and that goes on your credit. I've got to get away from this company. They are horrible

reviews.author: Ed
reviews.review_text: After calling TFS 4x I was able to speak to 3 different reps and all 3 confirm the same amount of the pay-off balance and it will take 2 to 5 business day to complete the transaction. I made the payoff same day the fund was withdrawn by TFS before midnight according to my bank. The following day I checked and noticed that I was charged for 2 days of interest for something that was paid in full he previous day. I called TFS and was informed that the interest for the car to be paid in full. Asked the rep if the interest for day 1 I purchase it or after the payoff I inform the rep that the funds was drawn by TFS before midnight, so it is paid in full. And told him charging 2 day of interest after it's paid in full is ridiculous. THis conversation takes 23 mins before he agreed to cancel the extra interest.

reviews.author: Genoveva
reviews.review_text: Me giving them one star is generous. Wish I could give them none. Where do I start? Customer service is a joke. I was always calling to change my payment date from the 5th to the 15th because I always pay rent on the 1st. The reps would always tell me “okay miss Patricia a change has been updated on your contract”. NEVER WAS IT MADE!!! I was always scheduling payments. It would go from “pending” to “approved” to week later saying “insufficient funds”. I started noticing the funds were never being taken out. THEN this is what I really noticed. It was when I had paid off their loan and I had the remaining balance of just the vehicle the funds were really not being taken out. They repo my vehicle after 2 months of “backed up” payments. Wanted me to pay the 2 months and the future payment and the repo place and the police station also the dmv totaling to $2400. I did not have that money laying around. I had just paid rent. It was 4th July weekend. They didn’t know I could track my vehicle. The car was in the lot. Sold in auction. Guess where it was at? BACK AT THE LOT WHERE I FIRST PURCHASED IT. They paid the remaining of what was due. Sent me a letter to pay $2400. They damaged my credit for 7 years. Horrible people. This should be illegal.

reviews.author: D
reviews.review_text: This survey is for Toyota Financial Services- .My payment suddenly changed 11 month into the contract 62.75 per month through the automated system. I called in on the 12th of December. Talked to a agent who after about 30 minutes of looking at my account transferred me to Rafael (manager) - ** who told me that they had made a mistake and that the tax added to my account would be adjusted and removed due to the contract I signed. I called back 12/17, and 12/18 checking to see if the adjustment was made and nothing was done. I called at 7:30 am. Was told that this new payment has always been the payment and that I would have to provide the documents and call the Dealership where I leased the Truck. I received the doc that proves I was tax exempt and still was given the run-around and was on the phone for over 5 hours. Today (12/19/25) spoke to Joesph ** who told me that I could not send him the document proving what my payment is and that I will have to wait another week 3 to 5 more business days and that I will not know whether my issue is resolved. I uploaded a document proving that I am tax exempt and I was told that Joesph could not review it and that administration would look at it and may resolve the issue (but may not and no promise of any response). I am so upset that I may never do business with Toyota again. I have owned several Toyota vehicles and have never experienced such terrible customer service. Then when the survey came for customer service it said it was expired. WOW, I have waited a week and then put on hold for at least 10 hours total for this issue, been disconnected, and then told that I cannot send the info to them directly and they could not see the documents. TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. I need to trade my vehicle and no longer do business with this company if this is the new way they are going to operate.

reviews.author: Joseph Matthew
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services didn't do everything wrong. That's why they get two stars. But they have two accounts in my name due to errors of their own making. This lead to me being stuck on the phone with customer service when I was trying to pay the first bill. None of this is the end of the world. But it was obnoxious to experience. However, this problem was not the end of the problems. I bought the truck on the 3rd. Was supposed to pay on the 3rd of the following month, which I did. A week later, I get an obnoxious letter explaining that the next payment is due on the 17th. I just paid them. How they determined this new date fascinates me. Is this to boost their quarterly reports? Beats me. But I do know I have to call customer service again, which is OBNOXIOUS.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.review_text: Round Rock Toyota Review: I’m 70, and I’m sharing this so other people — especially seniors — don’t end up in the same situation. I brought $22,000 in down payment/trade equity on a 2025 Camry with an MSRP around $28,000. But Toyota Financial Services later showed I was somehow financed at $48,000. I had another Toyota dealership look at my paperwork, and they immediately said the numbers looked “stacked.” That was the moment I realized this wasn’t just a simple misunderstanding — the structure of the deal didn’t match what I was told in the finance office. No one — especially an older buyer — should walk in with that much cash and walk out with this kind of imbalance. I’m posting this to help protect others. Please slow down, read every figure, and don’t assume the contract matches the conversation. If this helps even one person avoid what I went through, it’s worth posting.

reviews.author: John
reviews.review_text: I will forever say this: go with a credit union. Toyota Financial is worse than B of A. They have messed up multiple payments and even messed up their own deferred payment offer. Their customer service is atrocious. It’s like they don’t care to help. In an economy like this, their business won’t last much longer. When we can excise you like the tumor you are, it’ll be goodbye forever Toyota financial and Toyota vehicles. Let’s go Honda!

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.review_text: My experience with Toyota Financial Services over the last month of November raised major red flags in how they handle payments, account accuracy, and customer communication. Despite having more than enough funds in my account, Toyota repeatedly reversed my payments, then insisted my bank had “rejected” them. After speaking with my bank directly, I learned that: No ACH payment attempts were ever sent by Toyota. No declines occurred. No insufficient funds alerts were generated. No ACH trace numbers existed for the supposed returns. In other words: Toyota was claiming my bank rejected transactions that were never initiated in the first place. I spent the entire month of November dealing with contradictory explanations, scripted responses, and misinformation from multiple representatives. Not one person mentioned that Toyota’s system takes 24 hours to refresh account balances, which would have prevented half the confusion. Instead, I was left to untangle the situation on my own while being told things that were simply not true. It wasn’t until I pushed for escalation and requested verifiable ACH details (which Toyota could not provide) that the issue was finally clarified by someone competent. Let me be crystal clear: My bank was never the problem. Sufficient funds were present for all attempts. Toyota never sent the payment requests they claimed were rejected. Late fees were generated due to Toyota’s internal errors, not customer fault. For a financial institution, this level of inconsistency and misinformation is unacceptable. If you are experiencing similar issues—reversed payments, unexplained late fees, or claims your bank rejected payments without supporting documentation—I strongly recommend filing a complaint with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB). The CFPB can investigate when companies mishandle payments or give misleading information. Consumers deserve accuracy, transparency, and accountability. I did not consistently receive that from Toyota Financial Services throughout November.

reviews.author: Rodolfo
reviews.review_text: On Nov. 20, 2025, I called Toyota Financial Services to explore my options of terminating my lease early. The first rep. asked the usual questions; my name, lease contract number, year and model of car, etc. only to inform me that she’ll transfer me to right department. Well after getting transferred to a 6th department, Andrew, “ID ** of Voluntary Surrender Dept.” instructed me to “bring the car to the dealer (Toyota of Carlsbad, CA) then call him back.” When I asked what happens next he said that “the car will be auctioned about 5 to 10 days,” to which I asked, "Can you give me some idea of what it will cost me?" He calculated 27 payments of $480 = $12,900. To which I responded, "Wait, you said the car will be auctioned off, how does that relate to the number you just calculated and how does that process work?" And Andrew responded “I don’t know.” So I asked to talk to somebody who know like a supervisor or a manager. This time he placed me on hold for 15 mins!! This has got to be the most horrible customer service experience.

reviews.author: Diana
reviews.review_text: All Financial institutions requires proof of insurance from time to time but the way TFS handles is is nothing short of harassment. To get another 4 messages consecutively within minutes AFTER SENDING the relative document, is NOT ACCEPTABLE. THERE SHOULD BE A LAW AGAINST THIS!!! I will never finance through them again. This is the 3rd time I have encountered this irritating behavior. They claim to have tried to contact me which is a diabolical lie and then continue to harass me. I have not come across this behavior in any other financial provider.

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.review_text: Aside from counting down the days til my lease ended because of how much I hated the Rav 4. After my lease being paid off at trade in, Toyota still charged me for my monthly payment. Probably hoping I would notice. Toyota sucks

reviews.author: Leanne
reviews.review_text: I do not recommend going through Toyota Financial Services. Make a payment and they refuse to write a letter for a minimum of 30 days. The letter is the last thing is needed for a mortgage company and by the time the letter is wrote and mailed to me, I will lose out on a house. Also calling them isn’t easy, they constantly hang the phone up on you.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.review_text: I’ve had 2 loans with TFS & I could have never imagined the traumatic discoveries I’ve made recently. It’s a lot, so I will try to summarize. To start, I recently discovered blatant forgeries on the contract copy they provided me and there were alterations made every copy they sent to me throughout last year. They acknowledged the alterations on recorded calls and blamed the dealership, which I doubt is true. Towards the end of my last loan, they nearly doubled my final payment with zero explanation and despite the many calls for hours with them going over every single detail of my account and it being paid off and overpaid on early, they demanded I pay or my car be repossessed. They and the dealership led me on for a couple months that it wasn’t that serious and upper management would be in touch with me, which never happened. They reported me late for 3 months! This year, I was finally provided documents I had been requesting for several months. One document was a letter that was withheld from me acknowledging blank spaces on my contract, and a totally different VSC provider company than what’s on my contract. This letter claimed corrections were made, but the only change was the forgeries and one of which was originally a blank space. The VSC they had on file for me has a higher sale price and again, the signatures are not consistent at all with the original I still have. This is breach of contract and fraud on multiple levels. The credit application TFS has for me on file that they sent me is altered and significantly backdated. The first loan I had with them was a total loss and was being closed out when I bought the other car. The application is backdated to the same date on the claims check when they received it. They let me go over a month not knowing I had no financing and sent me a new contract that was backdated and to the same date as the first loan's contract! They have reported false loan information to the credit bureaus for both loans that has caused severe damage to my credit and will continue to for another 9 years! 8 years so far! That’s 17 years! I have sent them evidence of all this and made over 7 complaint cases. They deny all of it! This has caused me so much harm that’s affected my health and now I’ve had to build a case and am taking this to court. I cannot go into too much details on the other things I discovered, it’s that bad. Get all your documents from them to compare to your original signed documents and make sure it all matches. Keep an eye on your account activity, because they overcharged me on 2 loans and tried to claim my father had requested a payment extension the same day they deposited the claims check! The letter they recently sent me that’s from that time allegedly, is so suspicious. TFS is the worst company I’ve ever dealt with in my entire life. They are putting me through so much torture and agony.

reviews.author: Krystsina
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, my experience with Toyota Financial Services has been extremely disappointing. Our vehicle was declared a total loss, and throughout the entire process, we received no communication or updates from Toyota Financial. I had to keep calling them myself to get any information. The website shows outdated and inconsistent data — every time I called, I was told a different amount than what I saw online. After both our regular insurance and GAP insurance had paid everything, the website showed a remaining balance of $970. However, when I called Toyota, they told me a completely different (and higher) amount, without providing any written confirmation. They said a letter had been mailed, but when I called on Tuesday, it turned out the letter had only been sent the previous Friday. It’s unclear how I was supposed to know about the payment due before receiving any notice. I was also told that interest was already being added daily — even though there was no information about this on the website and no documentation provided. When I tried to ask for clarification, the representative (Ashley) became uncooperative and eventually refused to answer further questions. The call quality was poor, and communication was extremely difficult. Also only Ashley asked to provide all the digits of your SSN!!! I paid the amount they mentioned, but when I checked the website the next day, there was another unexpected balance with no explanation. Overall, the customer service is unhelpful and lacks professionalism. This will definitely be my last time financing through Toyota Financial Services. I strongly recommend choosing another company.

reviews.author: Sherry
reviews.review_text: If I can give a zero I would. They kept calling me 8 to 9 a day. Even called my job while on the floor working after I told them I can not accept calls while on the floor. She called on dept telling him about me, then he came to me about what she said. They cut my hours due to them calling even when payment not due. Now hours cut I can't afford to pay on time due to this. Now my car gone. The rep said rudely, "I can't lose my job over this." Said, "Well you made me almost lose my job too." I'm a senior citizen trying make it. Now there going to make it harder for me to get another car. I'm surprised they're still in business working on commission. Never ever deal with them again. Have a co worker there doing him the same way too. Worst place to finance a car you will lose it.

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.review_text: I attempted to register my car in New York and needed title and permission from TFS. A fax was sent by the DMV to TFS but never received confirmation. Then I discovered TFS had received the fax, but FedExed the title without the permission letter as requested, which makes absolutely no sense. I was never informed that was done. After eight phone calls and conversations, I finally got TFS to send a permission letter to the NY DMV. Of course, it sent the wrong letter TWICE. Finally, I had to make the person at TFS stay on the line until the new letter was received, and even that one was not what the DMV had asked for although DMV accepted. This is outrageous, considering I have been a Toyota owner for over 40 years. As soon as possible, I will find another place to refinance my car. Never again with Toyota Financial Services.

reviews.author: Renny
reviews.review_text: Bad, bad, bad. There was a financial issue. Have it a financial issue and am struggling to make payments. A deferment is offered for a $430 fee. It is difficult to get a live rep on the line and each time.

reviews.author: Roderiqua
reviews.review_text: I can’t stand it. The customer service. I had surgery, nobody wants to help me. It’s overwhelming. My autopay keeps getting turns off. It’s like I love the car but it’s just a big hassle and they harass you after they the ones who disconnect your bank.

reviews.author: Hulice
reviews.review_text: I do not recommend financing a car through Toyota. After completing my 72-month contract, they still claimed I owed money and refused to negotiate or work with me despite my financial difficulties. Instead of offering solutions, they only demanded full payment and showed no willingness to help. The representatives who called me back were rude and unprofessional. This was my first car purchase, and I will never buy from Toyota again. They take advantage of customers and make the process extremely stressful. Please think twice before financing with Toyota Financial Services — they will rip you off and show no understanding of your situation.

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services is the worst company so far I have dealt with in the United States of America. I am warning potential customers to be aware of them, They are disingenuous, as a customer they took gross advantage of me, by exploiting me, they defrauded me and fleeced me out of hundred of Dollars and on top of that they ruin my credit. I took over the loan of my late husband after seeking their permission, and after paying them 6 months (November 2024 to April 2025), they refused to give me the necessary documents to license and get plates in my name. One of their feisty representative, without no compassion and remorse on February 26, told to do a voluntarily surrender of the vehicle, because I keep calling and enquiring when will I get the necessary documents to get the plate and to license the vehicle in my name. I finally did in April after consistently paying and the vehicle could not be license. The EVIL COMPANY PUT IT on my credit stating an false amount of money obligated to them, after they auction off the vehicle. This company must never get the chance to treat another customer how they have treated me in the time of bereavement.

reviews.author: Oksana
reviews.review_text: Never again I take a loan from this company. Charged me twice for my last payment but they claimed I didn’t pay twice. It says clearly on Toyota financial account I paid twice. Also my bank confirmed they took money twice from my checking account but Toyota financial says they cannot see that I paid. Are they blind? They are claiming now I still owe them money even though my account is closed and I received Already title but somehow they can’t figure out and see my payments made from my direct bank account. I called them couple times already. Seems like nobody knows what’s going on. Nobody can fix any problem.

reviews.author: darshan
reviews.review_text: I have a 2024 Highlander financed through this company at 5.75% APR. My vehicle was totaled. Total due today is $15,101. But if I want to pay off, which I have to do now, the amount is $15,199. You pay full interest plus a fine for paying off early. I have purchased a new vehicle using Honda Finance. If I decide to pay off early, Honda won't charge me the remainder of the interest. Also, it doesn't have any early termination fee! I have learned that Toyota is a parasite. Never buying their vehicles or using their Financial (by the way, the vehicle failed to deploy airbags despire severe front end damage. Bodyshop tech says they might be defective).

reviews.author: Marlin
reviews.review_text: The worse. Prior to Covid they had options of calling and paying 24/7. Now not only do they exploit outside staff outside the U.S. in the billing department, but there is no one to talk to on the weekends. I had proof I was in the hospital as well for two months which is why I missed my payments starting this year but despite me paying they still repoed my car. I paid $100 towards the repossession office and in addition it takes one day for them to process the documents of release on both parties — Toyotas and the repo office so although I paid my fee I ended up paying $20 paying the repo office a total of $120 instead of $100 because they could not release the vehicle the same day. Then they were both blaming each other on how they process this. It is also not the first time I run into rude customer service reps. The recorded line does not help anyone but they. I did not realize there is truly not such thing as grace period—always pay before you dude date you will get a late fee. Then when I had the remaining $423.00 to pay to finish off the reinstatement of repossession, although I have written records of times and agents I spoke with including the repo Toyota department— they applied it to the regular account and it took 2 months for them to apply correctly. It has not been the first time they have also applied incorrect late fees and back in July of last year they processed my payment twice without my consent ultimately overdrafting my account and yes I had to call and complain to be refunded I only authorized for a one time payment of $574.47. I have been told to pay before 3 PM eastern time and before or on the due date. It is Friday July 18,2025 and I paid 10:17 a.m. pacific time which is 1:17 p.m. eastern time and it is not yet posted to the account. I have only received an email of “payment scheduled”. Thank goodness it is way before my 07/24 due date but this is what I mean of how inconvenient and inconsistent their payment system is. Also when I requested an updated bill as I made my payments of the reinstatement / repossession bill—they don’t have such a thing so it was a good thing I wrote every payment I was making. It was not the first time I was trying to explain my situation but I had agents ready to argue when they do not understand my frustration which I have repeated to them has nothing to do with them but Toyota’s banking loan system. I had some wonderful agents yes but most are strange and not equipped to understand this is nothing personal when we vent which if I had cursed at them or had not emphasized this has nothing to do with you, etc. I would understand their lack of empathy and I am not asking anyone baby me however as an also customer service representative I am doing collections unless someone is cursing at me directly no—I will not take a customer’s—by evidence—clear lying behavior of lack of payment personal. Whether or not the customer pays I will not lose my paycheck and if anything their payments feed me. The least I can do is try to facilitate or just allow the customer to vent unless it is a direct emotional dump or discrimination/ harassment of any sort towards my interactions. Toyota agents could use better training and that should start with the owners of the bank. If it was not for us the customers the rich bank owners and system would not eat plain and simple. In my case no—I was ready with medical documents to present and I was given no option and still—when I paid they repoed my vehicle and charged me more immorally not just the repo release to them but also to the repo company and to the local police department. Their morals and lack of options for payments and their system of processing the payments is unacceptable. I can purchase a bagel at a local mom and pop's and see my account posted immediately on a Friday or Saturday. There is no excuse for Toyota’s cut on sufficient employees anymore. They’re rich enough to gain the same amount of employees they laid off during covid now so we as customers can have better payment options. I have also requested certain documents via email like an updated bill of my total balance that includes the interest — well they send it encrypted without the ability of creating an account to open it. And yes I have tried all options on this both on Google chrome and while using a laptop instead of my smart phone. These banks are absolutely out to get the most vulnerable which is the working class so unless you have half of at least, or all $36K in cash or saved up ready — do not fall for their loan systems keep records of all the people you spoke with, and what you have paid whether written or typed. Also repo offices should report what they are paid because they force people to pay in cash. That needs to change. They should pay taxes the very same way the working class does.

reviews.author: Diane
reviews.review_text: Do not misconstrue my message, I love my Toyota car. It’s my fourth lease, the issues in the past but more so after this last call is about Toyota Financial Customer Service. These people are not experienced or versed to help you. I don’t usually demean anyone that’s in Customer Service or that is trying to help me but they do not know what they’re doing. They read from some kind of script like a robot and I had a gentleman first phone call. Tell me he’s putting me in collections and I already had paid my lease so obviously there’s some glitch with my bank, etc. The money is taken out it showed Toyota Finance got their money so he said we will put you in collections legally you can’t put anybody in collections to your 30 days past due, but I’m not worried about it because I hung up on him. The second girl told me that my merchant has to fax a report showing it came out on time which it did. My warning is really to Toyota. I hope they read this. You guys need to really step up with Toyota Finance and get some people there with some brains and experience because I will continue to buy this vehicle. It is awesome it never it’s never had a problem like I said it’s my fourth lease. It’s your Customer Service for Toyota Finance that is Horrendous. Do something about it because somebody’s not gonna wanna deal with it just considering buying that great car after they read this review in many more, you have a lot of horrible reviews only for Toyota financial.

reviews.author: Jamie
reviews.review_text: This isn’t even the full story of what I went through, just what I can manage to explain without writing a book. I was already under a tremendous amount of stress in my personal life. My hair was literally coming out from everything I was dealing with, and this situation with Toyota Financial only made things worse. It was a nightmare. What should’ve been a simple vehicle payoff turned into a mess of conflicting balances, no clear billing, and locked-out accounts. It took nearly a year and pressure from outside agencies just to get a basic ledger. And even then, it didn’t explain the extra charges. We ended up paying $494.46 just to get our title, even though we completely disagreed with the amount and how it was handled. Nothing was ever broken down or clearly explained, and that to me is deceptive. I filed complaints with Consumer Affairs, CFPB, and others, yet they’re still allowed to operate like this. With the number of similar stories out there and the fact that they just settled a class action lawsuit last year, this clearly isn’t an isolated issue. This is a much bigger problem. Toyota Financial has teams of lawyers and they know the legal loopholes, and that’s how they keep getting away with it. It should be illegal. Something needs to be done. Maybe if enough of us speak up, things can finally change. At the very least, we can warn others. That might be the most powerful thing we can do right now, to make sure others don’t have to go through the same thing.

reviews.author: Cara
reviews.review_text: A nightmare. I have had a lease with Toyota for four months and I've spent at least two hours on the phone with them each month. They've lost checks. I've sent them in the mail and failed to notate payments I've made to my account, and as a result, my credit has dropped by 99 points because they have wrongfully reported that I have failed to make payments when I have made payments on time all along. Cannot trust them to keep the money you sent them organized. You have to babysit/double check/follow up on any move you make to make sure it's done correctly. I wish I did not have a lease with them.

reviews.author: cassie
reviews.review_text: I bought a Toyota Camry 2022 for 22 thousand with a 3 thousand down payment of 12.42% interest. 520$ is my monthly payment. I was 8 months ahead on this, and asked if they could put those 8 months towards my principle. They said they would, but ended up making a TFS error and returned all of that to me. They told me it would take 7-10 business days, and here I am 13 days later with my bank claiming nothing is being processed and now Toyota customer service claiming the 5000 is in my Toyota account. I owed 19,000 on that car. And the 5000 she claimed was added to it, changed my owed payment to 19,483? So it went up in price? And my interest has not changed at all. So I'm wondering where my 5000$ went. But I'm going to my bank tomorrow to sort it out since they would not help me. Because all my transactions show where it says "returned payment," for several pay periods that I'm missing. Nor my account on Toyota or my bank has it, and my bank over the phone already stated I need to come in asap tomorrow because you are scamming me.

reviews.author: Lynne
reviews.review_text: We recently purchased our leased car and dealing with Toyota Financial has been our worst nightmare. It took 4 phone calls and finally a manager’s intervention to get a simple receipt for our transaction. Then, the title was issued incorrectly and that took 2 lengthy visits to the DMV and multiple phone calls to resolve. Worst of all, Toyota lied to us about why the title was issued incorrectly. I would never, never deal with them again.

reviews.author: Adnan
reviews.review_text: It has been 7 months that DMV/I am requesting a paper title copy from them to get my vehicle registered but despite repeated calls no Joy. Can’t drive my car and paying them money every month as it is not registered. Also, on every call after lengthy wait and discussion their agent tells that there is no solution as all their departments are isolated and there is no email address to communicate with them. After desperation once I asked them that I want to come out of this lease, take money and buy the car yourself they replied that till it is not registered we will not buy it, basically blackmailers, they rip you with your money and don’t provide any service, PLEASE AVOID THEM.

reviews.author: J
reviews.review_text: This has been the worst experience ever! As a result of this I will never buy another Toyota. Love the cars but this experience has soured me on toyota. Tried to pay off my loan. They took multiple payoffs. Now dealing with my bank to recoup my own money over 10000 in the whole because of them. If dealership tries to offer Toyota Financial cancel the purchase immediately. Worst company ever.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.review_text: On May 30 I made a payment to TFS. Not only did they take out the payment They took out 3 payments. When I called TFS they said it's a glitch in the system. Now 10 day later and 255 in fees I'm still dealing with it. And of you call TFS you get a call center in India and they can't understand anything. Absolutely appalling. Toyota needs to do better.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.review_text: I had only 5,000 left on my 2016 Toyota Camry SE from 19,000. I paid 14,000 and I told them I lost my job if they could work with me. They didn't and repo my car. It took me two week to find it and get the other out. I wanted to get my license plate off but the tow company who are also disgusting wouldn't let me. Then this joke of a company the Toyota wanted to charge me 900 for the tow and repo expenses. Sure I'll pay the 900 then give me my car back. So I pay 14000 for a car I do not have. They are a scam. Do not go to them.

reviews.author: Nelly
reviews.review_text: If there was a zero score I would have chosen it. Their customer service is horrible. I spent over 4 hours yesterday trying to get the correct number for the extended warranty. They gave me six different numbers to which they said I had no contract. Horrible service and the representatives lack empathy and willingness to help. They just transfer without even trying to figure out and help the customers. They appeared lazy, just want a paycheck without having to work.

reviews.author: Sean
reviews.review_text: Toyota is not the same company it once was in reliability or customer service. I have a 2006 Toyota Prius that's had normal wear and tear over the years, but has given me very little headache over the years. I recently purchased a brand new 2025 Corolla Cross Hybrid and after 2 weeks the car had mechanical issues. Working with the dealer, Toyota brand engagement and TFS has been nothing but a headache. My car (purchased on April 19) has now been in the shop, since May 4, 2025 - I've been without my brand new car longer than I was able to drive it. In addition to the car issues, canceling the two extended warranties I purchased with my car has been a nightmare between the dealer and TFS. First, they make you go back into the dealership to cancel the warranties (so tough luck if you're traveling or live far from the dealer). Then it took the dealer a week to process the cancelation and send a check to TFS - it would've likely taken longer, if I hadn't kept calling/emailing them about it. TFS then takes a few weeks to apply the refund to your loan - during this time you're still paying interest on the amount that is being refunded. I would strongly advise anyone considering a Toyota to either purchase a used vehicle that you have checked out by an independent trusted mechanic before purchase or go with another car maker like Honda or Subaru or even Hyundai.

reviews.author: Georgia
reviews.review_text: TFS is the absolute WORST company to deal with. If I could give them a ZERO, I would. I got married and need to change my name on my TFS LOAN AND TITLE papers, because we have moved States and I need to register my car in my new State. Sounds simple...right? Wrong. The Alabama DMV and I have been trying to get this done since the 2nd week February and this is now the last week in May. The Fax numbers don't pick up to receive the documents. The Certified mailed copies of the Forms that Toyota sent as well as the Marriage Licenses, have now been mailed. I am still receiving letters from Toyota that "changing my name on the account isn't necessary." YES IT IS. The State of Alabama requires that my name on the Toyota account and Title match the name on my new driver's license. I have spent hours on the phone, at the DMV, the DMV cannot get to the FAX number that Toyota Financial provides, there "is not a phone number to contact" where we can talk to someone in the College Station, TX office where TFS had us mail the Certified copies. AND...there is no email address to send. The only method to contact them is the general 800 number with the answering systems all over the world. I will NEVER buy another Toyota (I have purchased 3). Who in the year 2025 only communicates through a FAX machine - completely antiquated. All I want to do is to update my name, and they act like nobody ever has gotten married, divorced, etc after they purchase a Toyota. RIDICULOUS.

reviews.author: nicole
reviews.review_text: If I could give them a zero in every single platform I would. I am about to pull my hair out messing with TFS!!! They've taken multiple payments out the past 2 months, now saying I'm late, past due and payments never received!! I sent over my merchant reports from my bank & am being told that they cannot assist me because I'm past due???? I've requested to speak with a supervisor the past 2 months to be denied constantly. Or to be told there are not any people with any sort of authority to rectify this situation. So I reported them to the consumer affairs then if I don't get a resolution there I will contact the bbb.. Then I will get my attorney involved.. Do not buy a Toyota and have to deal with these rude incompetent people. I also know all of this that stemmed from my very first interaction with these hateful foreigners.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.review_text: I have been trying for 24 hours to pay the full settlement amount on my PCP. Everything on my side is set up and my bank can see that everything should work - But TFS system refuses to take payment. Wasted day and the prospect of more waste seems inevitable. My dealership says it cannot help. Useless.

reviews.author: SDF
reviews.review_text: This company is horrible, they steal your money and their app is not accurate, long short story I was trying to pay off the account and they added thousands of dollars out of nowhere saying I was making my payments for the principal not the monthly payments which is not true. Do not go there. You will see a hurt on your finances. Try other bank when financing. They will always charge you lots of money out of nowhere. If I can get legal advise so I can give my story will be helpful so I can stop this company from stealing its clients.

reviews.author: Jenifer
reviews.review_text: Sebastian from Toyota Financial Services is probably the best thing that has happened to this company in a long time!! It takes absolutely forever to get ahold of someone & then when you finally do it’s as if these people are not trained correctly or simply just don’t care to actually help you find a solution. It’s hard to come across someone who knows how to directly get to a solution. This man deserves a raise or bonus or something for his fast, efficient, professional demeanor. He got my situation handled within the first 5 minutes of being on call with him. When I called the first time it took so many avenues to come to a solution that was going to take way longer than it had to. I decided to call back because the solution given to me the first time seemed too complicated when it was Toyota who messed to begin with not me! The laziness of most employees that come from this company are beyond me. Moral of it all, glad I called back & got placed with someone who actually knows what they’re doing. This company can only pray to have more employees like Sebastian. ID #** for reference.

reviews.author: Keirstine & William
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services does not report to credit bureau if it's a commercial loan. $80,000 we paid them over 6 years on 2 consecutive loans with no "credit" for it in anyway. TFS has hurt our Church in an immeasurable way. Without proof of 2 paid vehicles through TFS we're stuck either doing business with TFS or not at all. Scam, fraud don't come close to taking advantage of a Church.

reviews.author: Lon
reviews.review_text: This company will rob you if they can. We are owed a little over $6,000 from a gap claim. And instead of paying us the legal amount. They want to charge us instead for a little over $200. They know the cost of an attorney would evaporate what they owe. Avoid this company at all costs.

reviews.author: W
reviews.review_text: TFS is a predatory lender. Their online payment system is ran entirely on AI with zero options for human interaction and they are currently committing a felony against our non-profit organization by not applying payments made accurately to our account in the amount of $1,200+ dollars of Church funds.

reviews.author: Carl
reviews.review_text: I bought a 2021 C-HR for my daughter in 2021, it was brand new. I make every payment like clockwork. Tonight 4-9-25 at 9:15 pm a tow truck showed up to repo it and scratched it hooking up to it. I showed the guy my receipt where it was paid 4-5-25 and he said "ok". unhooked the car and left. I won’t buy another Toyota. They will rip you off.

reviews.author: Camille
reviews.review_text: I am extremely disappointed with the service I received from Toyota Financial Services. I called to request payoff information with the intention of trading in my current Toyota for a new one, as I truly love my Toyota vehicle. Unfortunately, my experience was far from what I expected. I spoke with a representative named Darwin (ID #**), and he was not only unhelpful but downright rude. He ended the call abruptly by hanging up on me, leaving me without the information I needed. This level of customer service is completely unacceptable, especially when I’m a loyal Toyota customer hoping to continue doing business with the company. If customer service is important to you, I would strongly urge you to reconsider before choosing Toyota Financial Services. Based on my experience, I will be looking elsewhere for my next vehicle purchase. Disappointed and frustrated.

reviews.author: Rogue
reviews.review_text: Terrible experience. 3 weeks trying to update bank info... Alberni Toyota won't help... Online is all do it yourself... Then it's a week to have the paper processed and another few days to take payment... Then it will show you missed a payment when they are just lazy... because day 1 they get your commission... They get all your info set up... After that nobody cares... Oh and they text you every morning to remind you that a payment is missed but they can't get the money ... only text about it... Too many people letting computers do their job... May choose a Honda next time.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.review_text: Would STRONGLY DISCOURAGE anyone from financing your vehicle purchase thru a loan with Toyota Financial Services! Had a loan with them for my 2020 4Runner. Last payment made this month. Called to ask when I'd get title and confirm loan acct will be closed out only to be told that since I'm on auto-pay with monthly payment they will continue to take my money even after loan paid off, and never answered my question as to when I'd get my title. They told me the only way to stop the monthly auto payments was to go to my online acct myself with personal computer and turn off "recurring payment." WHAT A SCAM AND SO ILLEGAL!!! Not sure why they have a financing dept staff if I have to do their work for them. Never in all my yrs having loans with banks or other dealerships has this ever happened. BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: Marshall
reviews.review_text: GAP is a scam. I had a GAP claim that I attempted to file for weeks, diligently calling and verifying that I was submitting the correct paperwork. Despite my efforts, the online system continuously showed missing documents with no clear guidance. Submitting documents online only allowed one copy. I kept being asked to turn in all 4. After multiple calls and wasted time, I was finally informed that I could fax the documents instead. I promptly did so. I then proceeded to pay off my vehicle completely out of pocket. After waiting yet again, I received a denial of my claim. The entire process had already been frustrating, riddled with miscommunication and incompetence. At that point, I simply wanted to be done with GAP. I attempted to cancel my policy, only to be denied—something I wasn’t informed about until three weeks later. I spent weeks waiting for responses, chasing down paperwork, and receiving little to no real assistance. In the end, canceling my claim meant taking a financial loss. I paid off my vehicle, and instead of GAP providing the protection it was supposed to, I end up losing money. This entire experience has been nothing short of a scam, with zero accountability or competence from GAP staff. I lose money by paying off my vehicle and lose money on the amount GAP keeps.

reviews.author: Cyrus
reviews.review_text: When Toyota Financials sends us our Billing Statement, it does NOT say that if you mail your payment, it might take 2 weeks for them to receive. They don't even consider Holidays, etc. We bought the car recently. Although, we mailed our car payment way before the deadline, they've charged us LATE FEES twice so far. They claim that they received it after the deadline! I am suspicious that they've planned that way: When to send the statement & when to receive the payment. How come the Post Office delivers Xmas cards within 2 or 3 days during busy time of the year, but when it comes to Toyota, it takes them a few weeks to deliver?

reviews.author: T.J.
reviews.review_text: Horrible customer service. I have been fighting with them for over a month to get them to produce the title for my already paid off vehicle. They made an error and now will take no effort or responsibility to correct it.

reviews.author: Erik
reviews.review_text: I will start by stating I overpay, never miss payments and can pay off the loan if I wanted to. With that said. I have financed several vehicles in my lifetime and have never been treated so poorly by any company. Toyota lied about many things to get my business and CHANGED major DETAILS AFTER signing for the vehicle. I have been overcharged more than once. They have taken money out of my account WITH NO AUTHORIZATION AT ALL and have REFUSED to refund the money they took without permission. At the time they took the money, I was 4 payments AHEAD and overpaid by 2.5k intentionally. There was zero reason for what they have done. I called their number to cancel the payment, which they REFUSED. I insisted because they took that payment on their own after I had already made the monthly payment earlier that day. Nothing was overdue, they just felt like they should get EXTRA money for nothing. Now I am going to be evicted from my home because they took/stole money from me WITHOUT PERMISSION.

reviews.author: Linnea
reviews.review_text: I traded my car in October. I called and gave them my new address. They started sending like credit checks out. I got 2 of them at my address. So I’ve been waiting for my GAP check since then. I called multiple times to check on it, they said it should be here soon. I called first of January and they said they sent to old address. How come, when the checks before it came to the new address so they said they would resend it but end of January and still not here. I’m really not going to get my money I guess. The customer service was nice. I guess being nice while lying to you is easy.

reviews.author: Go
reviews.review_text: Very bad customer service. I request to speak with the managers many time but nobody care. No calls. I will say this place not the right place to give your money, very bad. I paid extra money to my account.

reviews.author: R
reviews.review_text: Tried to sell car privately from a lease, several reps I spoke to said this could be done. I filled out the paperwork they sent (Toyota Financial) and sent a cashier's check. They asked me to fill these forms out two additional times and in the end sent the title to the wrong person and wrong address. I know they had the right address on file since it was a higher tax location and I was paying more at the current address. In the end this became a three month long process and was almost a grand more than it should have been. I hope I never need to deal with Toyota Financial again.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.review_text: Absolutely terrible Phone payment system now as they want your SS# AND your long acct #. Who has that on them! Tried the App and can never log in. Every month is a challenge to make payment. 👎 It almost feels intentional.

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.review_text: I attempted to pay off my car loan with Toyota Financial Services (TFS) on August 13, 2024, by sending in a check. However, at the beginning of September, I received a notification that I was behind on a loan payment. Concerned, I contacted Toyota Financial to inquire about the situation. During my call, a representative from TFS informed me that they had not received my check and that I needed to make a payment to avoid late fees. Initially, Toyota had informed me that they received the check, had processed my loan to a zero balance, and had released the lien on the title. However, about 30-40 days later (around September 23), after the check had been sent, they reestablished the loan and indicated that the payoff was not processed as originally agreed. Following this, I cancelled the check. M&T Bank has documented evidence showing that the payment was made. It appears that there was internal miscommunication at Toyota Financial, as one department reported receiving the payment while another did not. I have made multiple attempts to reach out to Toyota's customer service through my loan account, but their response was dismissive, only stating that I was behind on my payments. They provided no further assistance or clarification. After this incident, I received the free and clear title to the car about two weeks later, but despite this, I continued to face issues when trying to resolve the situation. I called Toyota multiple times, trying to pay off the loan for the original amount I had sent in August, minus the most recent payments. However, Toyota informed me that the payoff amount had increased and they would need to seek approval to potentially forgive the additional interest. This response was unacceptable to me, as there was no guarantee they would do so, and I felt Toyota was mishandling the situation. Their actions were damaging my credit, and I lost confidence in Toyota Financial Services' ability to resolve the issue fairly and competently. On December 13, I attempted to reach out again, but once again, I was met with unreasonable responses. TFS insisted that I allow the check to go through their process, which could take several months. I believe this is an unfair and unreasonable delay—especially given that any legitimate car loan service should be able to process a payoff within 30 days. It feels like I am being extorted for the additional interest by Toyota Financial Services, which is unacceptable. I have continued to make payments in September, October, November, and December, but I am still accruing interest, which is frustrating and unjust considering the error was on Toyota's part. Therefore, I am requesting that Toyota allow me to pay off the loan for the amount I initially attempted to pay in August and waive any interest that has accrued since then due to their mistake. If Toyota Financial Services continues to make things difficult, I will consider taking further action to regain ownership of the car without additional payments. I am questioning their legal claim to the loan or the vehicle, especially since they released the title to me. At this point, their behavior is more reminiscent of a coercive organization, not a legitimate financial service. They are preventing me from paying off my loan, damaging my credit, and jeopardizing my job due to my security clearance. I am seeking assistance to help resolve this matter and to investigate how many other individuals Toyota Financial Services may be mistreating with either their incompetence or what feels like extortion.

reviews.author: S
reviews.review_text: There is a credit servicing agency for mortgage companies that somehow are asked to reach out to Toyota Financial to give credit information They call you and conference you in. Toyota financial rep did a cursory “consent” that doesn’t really specify what type of information is provided to the credit reporting agency except “call is recorded“, “do I have the permission“ and then gives information that one would rather not get revealed to the credit reporting agency. They do it anyways and it’s humiliating and embarrassing. When redirected to give just the necessary information, they get snippy and when I request a supervisor that clearly boundaries are crossed, they say “it will take 2 business days“ or something in those lines, these staff have no respect for privacy of financial information for their clients. Had a terrible experience today.

reviews.author: Marlisse
reviews.review_text: While it’s great to have a lease option this company fails at everything surrounding your lease! First off paying your bill is an utter nightmare for everyone it seems getting logged on is a huge hassle resetting info each time. Secondly and the reason I am returning to the dealership for another option is my spouse passed away, I have contacted Toyota Financial every month for four months now because the state I live in requires a letter to have my deceased spouse's name taken off the CTA to register my car. Absolutely NOTHING HAS BEEN DONE AND I AM UNABLE TO REGISTER MY CAR! These bean counters have shuffled me off stating it will be done yet when I call each month thus far 7 calls 45 minutes a call I get NOWHERE! I am DONE WITH TOYOTA FINANCIAL.

reviews.author: Nichole
reviews.review_text: 0 would be my rating of Toyota Financial!!! My car was totaled on June 24 2024. They received a check from my insurance company JULY 23 2024 and I have yet to receive the reimbursement check for the extra payment that was made. It is November 23, officially 4 months later. Once again I was told another 2-3 weeks. I feel like this is fraud!

reviews.author: Belinda
reviews.review_text: My car is currently leased through their company. Their website is a total time waster. You can never log in. Something is always wrong. I have the hardest time reaching anyone with customer service and overall just a horrible experience. With Toyota being a big company you think that they would be able to do better. Paying my bill monthly leaves me with anxiety and is a huge hassle. I am currently looking to refinance to get out of this nightmare.

reviews.author: Branden
reviews.review_text: 0 stars. I don't recommend Toyota Financial to my worst enemy. I hit a deer and totaled my car over a month ago and the customer service on the phone is OK, but the whole operation of Toyota Financial is terrible. My insurance sent out the payment for my car 3 weeks ago and they keep telling me their payment processing is backed up. The woman said she's not supposed to give me a time frame for the payment to be processed but she said it will take another 30-45 days. I work 45 minutes away and this is just absolutely the worst time in my life. I'll probably end up losing my job pretty soon because I can't afford to book any more hotels or rides to get to work. It is the most frustrating, depressing situation I have ever been through thanks to Toyota. Please do yourself a favor and go through a bank or credit union.

reviews.author: James A
reviews.review_text: A complete joke. Inept phone reps. Almost 2 months and warranty refund checks did not process so payment stopped. Back to square one. They received 3 new checks and still waiting for processing. Bottom line is they are useless. No way to direct email them. If only they were as dependable as their cars. Seek financing elsewhere.

reviews.author: Elaine
reviews.review_text: I was never sent a title (finance company holds it per New Jersey regs.) in 2008 when I paid off my loan. Now, 2024 New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission won't process a clear title without a lien release. When I called Toyota, I wasn't even in the system anymore. Tax returns only need to be held for 7 years, why State of New Jersey thinks I can still get a title release is beyond me. Tried the dealer, no help there. Called Toyota again, now they will send the title release via snail mail. Meanwhile, I've already traded the car so the dealer has to wait. I doubt this missing title/lien release letter will show up. Not buying a Toyota again.

reviews.author: Natosha
reviews.review_text: Absolutely atrocious service, ridiculous phone bank and unhelpful staff. I work for a dealership and it is a nightmare to have to deal with these people on payoffs. I don't recommend them at all. Zero stars.

reviews.author: Meagan
reviews.review_text: I would give 0 stars if I could. Sent my insurance claim check to them September 18th for endorsement. Quoted a 7-10 business day turnaround time. It is now OCTOBER 22nd and no one can tell me where my check is!!!

reviews.author: Kiva
reviews.review_text: This company "DOES NOT" deserve a star. This is by far the "WORST" financial company there is! They hound customers down for payments then when customers pay, they pretend to not have received payments. I paid over $700 and they're telling me my payment has been cashed!!! How?? How do y'all know this but claim to have never received anything? Ya'll are responsible for payments received. I feel as though I have been scammed by these people & my $755 needs to come up asap! Now they're trying to take my vehicle that I paid for but won't return my $755 they claimed to never received!!!! NO SIR....

reviews.author: Kerry
reviews.review_text: I suggest Toyota Financial Services hire more people in their finance department in TX. It cannot be difficult to hire someone to data capture all the payment checks received!! My insurance company paid Toyota Financial Services eight weeks ago because my vehicle was totaled in an accident, I am still receiving notices to say I am overdue on my payments and Toyota Financial Services owes me over $1100 now. I need to purchase another vehicle and I need this money. I have called the customer services line many times, all they say is that they are short staffed and the check has been received. Some of the customer services agents are quite rude as well (I was not rude, just asked about my account being handed over to debt collectors). Come on Toyota, you are making a lot of money and you should be paying us interest on the money you owe us.

reviews.author: Enkhnaran
reviews.review_text: I am extremely disappointed with the service I received from Toyota Financial Services. I sold my car to Carfax on July 30th, and they promptly sent the check for the remaining balance to Toyota. However, Toyota Financial did not process the payment until three months later. This unreasonable delay resulted in Toyota falsely reporting missed payments and sending my account to collections. Despite the fact that the payment was sent on time, my credit score took a significant hit due to Toyota’s incompetence. Trying to resolve the situation has been a nightmare, with unhelpful customer service and no accountability for their mistakes. I expected better from Toyota, but this experience has completely shattered my trust in their financial services. Be cautious if you're considering financing through them—this could happen to you too.

reviews.author: Tanya
reviews.review_text: My car was stolen on Aug 6th. State Farm sent a settlement check to Toyota overnight address 2 weeks later. It’s been two months and my settlement check has not been processed. I’ve called over 20 times only to be told that they’re understaffed and the check was received. Meanwhile, I need to purchase a new vehicle, yet this car is still showing up on my credit as an open account, after 2 months which affected my credit score and rating!!! I’ve left messages over 10 times asking to receive a call from a supervisor and have yet to receive a callback. A class action suit needs to be established with Toyota Financial, they are absolutely unprofessional, nonresponsive and should be put out of business!!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.review_text: They are the worst to deal with. They charge you a late fee if a payment is late but the payment is auto deducted from my acct. They also waited one month to tell me that last month's payment was not taken out and is now late. No crap it's late, it's a month later and I am just getting put on notice now! Unprofessional. Please make sure you have another company buy them out so you do not have to deal with their stupidity.

reviews.author: Katelyn
reviews.review_text: My car was totaled and the insurance paid them in full months ago. During the time they had the check, they took out two automatic payments from me and cannot refund me the money until the check is processed. Their processing department is apparently months behind and still have not processed the check. Not everyone can afford to have that much money just gone. This is ridiculous and I will not be using them again.

reviews.author: Leonard
reviews.review_text: I have been a Toyota customer for a very long time, I leased three Tundra trucks, four Camrys, and two RAV4 SUVs. I just started a lease on a new Lexus RX350 which, is also financed through Toyota Financial Services. This most likely will be the last time I deal with Toyota ever. I extended my existing lease on an RAV4 in February for 6 months because Toyota did not have any RAV4s in inventory, the same situation happened in August which forced me to extend the lease for an additional 6 months period. I take care of my cars and they retain good value therefore I do not want to return my leased RAV4 and pay disposition fees, instead I want to trade it in for a new vehicle or sell it to get the benefit of equity. When I went to Faulkner Toyota in Trevose PA, where I got my RAV4, I met with a bad attitude and incompetence. After asking for a payoff letter I was politely told to have a seat after about 40 minutes of wait I was given a plain piece of paper, not letterhead with a few lines printed from the computer. When two minutes later I came back and questioned the "letter", I was rudely told to wait again by a guy at the front desk. A few minutes later a finance manager came out and informed me in a very irritated tone of voice that in her 15 years as a finance manager she had not seen any other type of letter. I had to call Toyota Financial and was told that they are no longer allowed to give payoff letters to customers directly, it has to be done by the dealership. I went back inside and after five minutes was able to give my cell phone to the finance manager. Even though the customer service representative was also shocked to hear that the dealership couldn't provide the payoff letter, she offered to type one up and email it to Faulkner Toyota's finance manager who would forward that letter to me. A seemingly simple task that should have taken a couple of minutes at the most, took over an hour and spoiled my mood for the rest of the day. Fast forward to September, I found a dealership that was interested in purchasing my RAV4 but they also needed the lease and payoff information. I dreaded going back to Faulkner Toyota but I had no choice. To my surprise, I did not have to wait longer than a minute or two, a guy from the finance took me to his office and in less than 30 seconds printed a formal payoff quote with a Toyota logo, UNBELIEVABLE! Maybe they should promote this guy to the position of finance manager and let the other one go? Unfortunately, my troubles were not over yet, when the dealer who wanted to purchase my vehicle ran a title check, it came back that Toyota Financial did not put me on record with the Department of Transportation as a "lessee" and I can not sell the vehicle. I was told to go to Auto Tag place and have that corrected. At Auto Tag agency I was told that to correct the record I have to get a "Power of Attorney" from Toyota Financial! After spending a couple of hours on the phone trying to explain to customer service representatives who are based outside of the United States and have difficulty comprehending what I am talking about and have no knowledge of what PennDOT is and subsequently hanging the phone on me four times, my frustration level reached previously unknown levels. Finally, on the fifth try, I got lucky to be connected to a guy who understood what I was talking about after I took down his name and employee ID. He assured me that the Power of Attorney would be sent out overnight delivery and I should have it the next day, Saturday or Monday at the latest. The letter did not come either Saturday or Monday. Monday afternoon I called Toyota Financial again and once again, the representative informed me that she is based outside of the Continental US. I asked to be transferred to a US-based customer service representative and after a short wait was greeted by a guy with a very heavy Indian accent and poor knowledge of English who once again went through a thorough verification of my account. He informed me that he was based in Arizona but I have no reason to believe it was true. He seemed to be very inexperienced, it felt like he was reading responses from some sort of customer service manual. During the call when I explained the reason for my call and what I needed he put me on hold numerous times for up to two minutes during which time I believe he was consulting with someone else. As a result, he told me that Power of Attorney was mailed to me on Friday but by regular mail. When I explained once again that I was promised overnight delivery and after another lengthy hold I was told that Toyota Financial Services does not provide overnight deliveries and I had to provide my Fedex account number in order to get it, as it is a common occurrence for any consumer to have a Fedex account. Frustrated, I tried to make him see the ridiculousness of his answer and explain that I was promised overnight delivery and FedEx account was never mentioned. I tried reasoning that after leasing nine or ten vehicles from Toyota and probably spending close to $250,000 company could afford to pay for overnight delivery or at least bill me at add it to one of my current lease accounts but he kept repeating that all we can do is wait for post office to deliver my letter by regular mail, over and over like broken record. In conclusion, he politely asked if there was anything else could do for me, WHAT A JOKE! Now I am forced to sit and wait for Power of Attorney to be delivered by mail, whenever that will happen after which I will have to pay god knows how much to have records which were screwed up by Toyota corrected, while I have to keep paying for a vehicle that is sitting in my driveway because I don't want to put more miles on it to diminish the value...This has been a very traumatic experience and I am considering involving an attorney to resolve this matter. I would strongly recommend staying away from Toyota altogether but if you can't, try financing it through other financial institutions, preferably your own bank.

reviews.author: F P
reviews.review_text: I, like many others, found my interaction with Toyota Financial to be an absolute nightmare. It took a while to finally figure out how to make contact with a real person (stay on the line, listen to 5 minutes of dribble unrelated to my problem, and then keep pressing zero, as there is no prompt to speak to a real person). All I was trying to do was get a copy of the title of a leased vehicle to reregister a car whose title had expired. It took over a month, and after probably 15 phone calls, six trips to the DMV (that's another matter), numerous broken promises to fax and/or email a copy of the title, changing story lines, etc. I finally talked to a rep today who was able to accomplish this most basic of requests in a matter of a few minutes. How the first 10+ reps I talked to could not handle this situation is beyond me. I was hung up on twice, was told to go to DMV and call from there (a useless endeavor ending on two separate occasions waiting in the DMV for a faxed copy, promised to be faxed in "less than 10 minutes", and which NEVER came). They kept insisting that I was in possession of the original title, an impossibility as it is a leased car owned by Toyota. The people at the DMV told me that this is a common occurrence with Toyota, and "if you think this is bad, wait until you try to get the title after buying out the lease." I could go on but I think I've made my point. I, like many others, would give zero stars if possible.

reviews.author: Pilar
reviews.review_text: We bought GAP insurance through Toyota Financial Services and we paid off the car on April, they were supposed to send us a check for $511 that we never received, upon calling them they said we already cashed out the check and they couldn’t do anything, we asked for a copy of the check to see who cashed the check since we didn’t receive it and we are still waiting, no money, no check, no answer, their customer service is rude and useless. Don’t finance anything with this company.

reviews.author: Klaus
reviews.review_text: Absolutely the worst company I have ever dealt with! I received an insurance check 2 1/2 months ago asked it to be credited towards the payoff of the vehicle and the payment was never posted after reaching out to them. Let’s not forget the multiple attempts to reach an individual through their worthless contact phone number.. Eventually got through. Was told they never received the check and was told to cancel with my insurance carrier which I did and they promptly sent out a new one. Once again I reached out to Toyota Financial Services. This time they gave me a different mailing address. After a month the payment still has not been posted and they are showing me as delinquent on my payment. Once again, I have talked to a representative who is courteous enough to call me back and she stated the situation is very important and it has been escalated to the next level. At this point, I’m totally livid! And what’s really terrible is I love the car but now I hate the company! Good luck to all who decide to use Toyota finance!

reviews.author: Shreekrishna
reviews.review_text: My Car was paid off, Got an overpayment check that got bounced.. And It's been almost a month they've not even started title processing stating that there's some accounting issue.. Tired of following up.

reviews.author: Miriam
reviews.review_text: Customer service is nice but their system is garbage. Reason I’m getting rid of this service after I get this vehicle paid off. Cost about the same as my Chevy. But when you hit a rough patch again because of your health and work life being as demanding it impacted my pocket I just wanted a month extension so I can pay the back amount and to change the due date and got denied even though I’ve been paying every month so far with no issues. But that isn’t allowed this is why I miss my financial institution at least they gave me a five month extension when I was out of work due to my medical issues and was getting back on feet. They cared that much. I give props to Chevy and Cap One for that. They really need to change Toyotas on how they handle their customers. Every case a different and they should really be more mindful and helpful

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.review_text: I have been attempting to get my title sent to my new state’s title office for weeks and have had absolutely no success. Toyota told me they had sent it to the title office within 1-2 business days but every time I call the title office they still have not received anything. When I try to call Toyota again I cannot get a representative on the phone! I have called multiple times and today I called at 4 pm CT and their office was already closed when it says they’re open till 8 pm online… They should at least be open till 5 pm CT as they’re located in Texas, so I guess I will just be driving with expired Texas plates here in Ohio as this has been a nightmare experience. I would give zero stars if I could. There is zero accountability and zero customer service! I so regret using Toyota Financial and want them to be held liable if I get pulled over for having no registration and expired plates due to their complete and utter incompetent!!!

reviews.author: Tiffany
reviews.review_text: Absolutely trash company. They keep changing the address for the pay off check to be sent to. Sent me a letter saying my loan was paid off and a check for gap insurance reimbursement, which bounced. I have called multiple times, each person transfers me to the next person. They keep telling me wait another two weeks. It’s been 3 months. You can file a complaints with a customer service rep, but can’t call administration to check on a update for the complaint. There is no administrative department to speak to.

reviews.author: Artbyerica
reviews.review_text: Don't finance a car from them. Also you can't reach anyone by phone typically. My dealer straight scammed me many times. Never buying or financing anything ever again. Heed my warning. Avoid my mistake!!!!

reviews.author: John
reviews.review_text: I'm trying to sell a car and instead of sending me a title after I paid off the loan they sent me a title that actually states, "Not good for use in sale of this vehicle." Tried to contact their customer service and they basically said it's my problem now.

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.review_text: If I could give Toyota Financial as well as Priority Toyota of Chesapeake Virginia 0 stars I absolutely would. I have never seen a company do such illegal, and disgraceful things to not only paying customers, but to 100% disabled Veterans at that. From changing a lease agreement somehow from 3 to 5 years even though not one dealership has heard of a 5 year lease. To refusing to provide documentation for 2 years due to moving to another state to update tags and registration. To now fraudulently not only trying to charge me personal property tax for the last 3 years even after providing all documents of being exempt and protected from paying as a 100% permanent and total disabled veteran this matter still remains in dispute with these charges still remaining on my account. Not only do they now somehow add over $150 to my already high payment which they state is Pennsylvania sales tax, but still refuse to send documents customer service has told me they will send and never end up doing so. I have spent countless hours on with supervisors, and managers at Toyota Financial guaranteeing me a resolution and to keep me “in the loop” with now months later yet again then still failing to keep their word. I again today sent the same documents and copies of emails in the mail again spending more money due to the severe negligence and dishonesty of this company as well as sales department.

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.review_text: After working so hard on my credit so I could finance a car without a co-signer I financed a Scion TC through TFS. 2 years later my car was stolen. I had 3 police report numbers, the officer who was handling my case I supplied all the information I had to TFS. The person who stole my car hit 3 other cars. Everything was under investigation. When my car was found it was towed to Green’s Towing in Hampstead MD. The towing company sold my car, TFS put the sticker price from the day I financed the car 12,999.00 on my credit report as a charge off. I was already 2 years in paying my payments. This is the worse case scenario that could possibly happen to anyone. How is this even legal? It’s been another 2 years and I am still trying to work this out with TFS. I am so sorry I financed a car through them, how crazy is my story. I’m punished for my car being stolen then sold by the towing company. How can they legally sell a car that belongs to Toyota in the first place and TFS not be notified. I have never heard a complaint like mine. This is what happened to me. I’m still calling, emailing, etc., whatever I have to do for however long to get this off my credit. I have been told many times by many people how bizarre this situation is. I would suggest using a different financial institution anyone other than TOYOTA FINANCIAL SERVICES.

reviews.author: David
reviews.review_text: I agree With others that this is one of the worst Customer services. Experiences I've ever received. I'm trying to Payoff/purchase my Vehicle. And all I get is an automated voice system that rarely. gets me to a real human being. Today July 17th I'm calling at. 3:20 PM. Mountain time. And even though they are supposed to be open until 5. PM, central standard time, They are closed. Furthermore. I'm getting. the Insane runaround with respect to whether I should Go ahead with the purchase through Toyota financial services or with a local dealer. Each one points to the other. as the proper place to go. When you are a customer and ready, willing and able to. pay over $30,000 cash To purchase a new automobile. It's just inexcusable to be treated this way by getting. the run around by not speaking with a real representative and being given conflicting advice as to where you should submit a large cashier's check of that magnitude.. I'm seeing that 89% of the reviews are negative, Toyota is a great automobile company, but Toyota Financial Services and the system of buying out your lease is a disgrace.!!

reviews.author: Dr. Dash
reviews.review_text: I was with Toyota Financial Services for over a decade. I recently leased a car & my city taxes went up by $1.00. I was on autopay having no idea that I was not paying the extra $1.00 monthly. They hit my credit with a 30 day late for $12. My credit score plummeted by almost 100 points!!! I was in shock to say the least. I called Toyota Financial Services not knowing why this happened. They were incredibly rude to me, while explaining everything. They did not care at all that I was a loyal customer for over a decade with stellar payment history (never been late). They were so rude to me even the Manager. They were so rude that I emailed the CEO, which his assistant responded back with the same rude tone. I could not believe that in all the years I have been their loyal customer, never been late on a single payment, they would treat me like this. I cannot believe how ill-mannered, inconsiderate, un-willing to listen, un-willing to help, not caring at all about my loyalty with them, and most importantly how less of a person they made me feel. They treated me like nothing. I will never give them my business again! My employees, family, and friends are all appalled by Toyota Financial Services. They do not care about you! They only care about their sales!

reviews.author: Bob
reviews.review_text: This is the worst experience I have ever had. Trying to purchase my leased vehicle sent the paperwork with a bank cashier's check for the payoff. No acknowledgment from Toyota that anything was received by them and I made several phone calls and you get different answers to the same questions from different representatives.
