A month has passed and they keep telling me I do not have to make my lease payment but now I see that they put a $20 late lease payment on my account. Although several agents told me my paperwork and payoff check was received but not yet processed. For a company that make great cars their Financial Services are the worst.

reviews.author: Mackenzie
reviews.review_text: They are not helpful to communicate with. I get transferred to multiple people every time I call. The last worker, Levi, was mumbling and I told him twice I could barely hear him. He told me I called the wrong department. I told him I didn’t believe so because I dialed the same number I called the last payment I made. He transferred me to someone who transferred me back to his department. I’m so glad I don’t have a payment with TFS anymore and if I ever own another Toyota, I will not finance through them. Save yourself the headache

reviews.author: Hussny/Sam
reviews.review_text: I know for sure our next car will NOT be from Toyota, so that we do not have to deal with Toyota Financial and the laziness and attitude of the employees in charge. We have set ourselves on Auto pay, for 5 years now, till the end. Yet we get a nasty note / letter from Toyota Financial that we are in default. We were charged late payment, threatened to be sent for Collection. For 5 years they are getting paid through "automatic payment". Yet the employees did not bother to check before sending the letter; did not try to check how we were paying for 5 years and simply take the lazy way to send us such irresponsible letter. Just reading the terrible reviews herein tell a lot about their level of care and professionalism.

reviews.author: Neighbor
reviews.review_text: I had a 2008 Toyota Corolla financed through them. I hit a deer a month and a half ago. Since then they have messed "EVERYTHING" up. They have not paid me my GAP that I cancelled. Then yesterday they pulled out another payment on my totaled car! I "WAS" in the process of closing on a new 2024 Toyota GR. This experience made me go buy a Honda R instead! Never again will I finance anything through Toyota.

reviews.author: M.
reviews.review_text: This company is just plain terrible. Once you finally get to talk to someone (which is quite difficult), they give you the run around - no one has any solid information. I have been trying to purchase my leased vehicle from them for 2.5 months now and it's still not processed. I was given 20 different instructions initially and 2 different numbers for payment and still am not clear on what was the correct route/payment. Would highly recommend NEVER using this as a financing bank.

reviews.author: Alana
reviews.review_text: They don't even turn their customer service phone lines on during their open hours, so you're stuck talking to a robot that's asking all the wrong questions because their "office is closed" (it's not).

reviews.author: Ronni
reviews.review_text: TOYOTA FRAUD ALERT! Toyota has not paid my member's Illinois sales tax on a vehicle we refinanced for him in December. The IRS is now charging him late penalties and interest. I have contacted Toyota SEVERAL TIMES to address this issue. Toyota filled out an ST-556 but NEVER made the payment. Now to clear this error up the Illinois Department of Revenue will need a copy of the check if it was actually paid. I don’t know why it is taking over 5 months with numerous calls and emails to get a copy of the check. If it was a human error then the funds need to be paid ASAP! Everyday I am told “it’s not my department”, “wait 1, 3, or 5 days for a response” or “I have now emailed the right department.” WHAT A JOKE! Listed below is everyone I spoke with and left messages/emails with as no one HELPED get this resolved. Toyota Team Members: Barbara ** Natalie ** Jacquelyn ** Yliana Zulma- ID # ** Grey-ID #** THIS STILL NEEDS ADDRESSED!

reviews.author: Darron
reviews.review_text: I'd provide less than 1-star if I could. The company purposely sets up recurring payments to reflect to future payments as a means to pull as much interest out as possible; therefore, consumers have two options: 1) go in every month and pay a Principal Only Payment following release of your initial monthly payment, or 2) call in every month to have the excess you've paid atop your minimum Monthly payment applied to principal. If you fail to do either above, the payment only applies to future payments; therefore, your APR is maximized for TFS and not the consumer. I've received better rates with easier payment options elsewhere and will never do business with TFS moving forward and advise future customers to visit lending brokers to receive the best rates/payment options.

reviews.author: David
reviews.review_text: This company is incompetent and not consumer friendly. They make promises to refund or rebate checks on total loss vehicles, and tie you up with processing times and misinformation. They screwed up processing of every document after my purchase of a vehicle as well. Made promises in deliverable times that they do not adhere to. They reissue checks, say 3-5 days process, and say they'll overnight check. Then you call them back, check hasn't been issued, 3-5 more days, with "no" overnight. 7-10 days in Continental U.S. Purveyors of misinformation and unmet deadlines. Can't be trusted at any stage of purchase or recovery of loss process. Will never go through them again.

reviews.author: Robyn
reviews.review_text: This review is specifically for Savannah. I am an authorized speaker on my fiancées account, it's actually my car but we financed under his name. Every time I call the representatives they are great. But when I spoke to savanna this morning, she stated she didn't see my name on the account though my fiancée has come on the line at least 5 times to verify it's ok to speak to me. How come all the other reps can see but not her? I felt on the defensive with her and she put me on hold for a long time without checking in so I had to hang up. I understand she is doing her job but ridiculous questions and her not seeing I was authorized is frustrating.

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.review_text: After my loan was paid in full my bank inadvertently sent an overpayment to Toyota Financial Services -TFS (my fault for not stopping auto payment in time). I notified TFS and they assured me the money would be refunded to me. When I did not receive my check from them after nearly 3 weeks I called and was told the check had not been issued yet. I spoke to an agent in the resolution department who assured me the check would be processed right away and sent to me by FedEx. Two weeks later - still no check, so I called again. I was told by another resolution agent that the check was issued and mailed a week ago - but not by FedEx - oops someone dropped the ball AGAIN. They cannot guarantee when it will be delivered by the postal service so I must just wait and see. I believe it is unacceptable that my refund should take well over a month to arrive and that even though there was full documentation regarding the issue, no one followed through with resolution. I will never finance a vehicle through them again.

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.review_text: I experienced what I learned to be sudden unintended acceleration (SUA) the night that I financed the 2014 Camry Hybrid. The dealership wouldn’t take the car back, nor did they even test it, but told me the problem was fixed. The next day, another SUA incident landed me in the hospital and the amputation of my toe. I called TFS seeking help 28 days before the first payment was due and told them I had no intentions of making a payment. They sent me back to the dealership. I called TFS back and they put me in contact with Brand Engagement (BE). BE was to bring in the vehicle for testing but TFS intervened to stop testing. Over the course of the next 9 months, the car was dormant in my carport. When they came to pick it up it wouldn’t even start. I begged them to be careful because of the SUA events. TFS had ordered the car be put up for sale with no testing as I was to learn later. Months after it was repossessed, I couldn’t locate the vehicle through the VIN. I finally reached someone who told me that in all probability the vehicle was taken off the road due because it was involved in a serious accident. I am still trying to determine what happened, but I don’t believe I will ever know the truth. I feel.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.review_text: Honestly I would love working for this company. No knowledge on any process or customer service skills required. I have called at least 13 times to try and get a copy of my title sent to a new state so I can register my car. As many other reviews have said, every single employee I spoke to had a different answer to my question. It is impossible to speak with a manager and when asking to speak to one the rep I was speaking to put me on hold mid sentence and gave me to someone speaking Spanish. When I called back to make a complaint and AGAIN try to speak to someone who could give me an answer to my question I was still shuffled around to different representatives. When I finally ask if I just pay the car off would I have to go through this process they STILL informed me they did not know the answer....absolutely worthless customer service department.

reviews.author: Riane
reviews.review_text: Worst customer service ever! I called so many times to their financial service due to my overpayment refund. I have received different answers or information whenever I call. I simply requested to send it to my current address because I’m no longer living there, like what they did to my car title. I don’t understand why in this simple request cannot do it right. All in all, despite of my several calls and requests. It turns out that they still send it to the wrong one! We don’t deserve this kind of stress. Avoid this company while you still have time.

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.review_text: This has been the WORST company to deal with as far as a loan. I have been locked out of my financial account for months and STILL have not been able to be let back in. I have been calling them every week for the past two months and each time there is a new agent with the same story. Ticket still pending or previous agents did not even submit a ticket. During this time they have been charging me TWICE and I am unable to remove payment methods because I am still locked out of my account. I will be switching my loan to another company. Wish there was a 0 star option. I will be escalating this issue as far as possible.

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.review_text: This is NOT a good place to get an auto loan. I got a car loan for a new Toyota and paid it off in full, weeks before the first payment was due. They still charged me $50 interest. I had to call them repeatedly, to obtain my car title and it took them months to send it, even though the loan was paid in full.

reviews.author: E
reviews.review_text: DO NOT FINANCE THROUGH TOYOTA FINANCIAL! The last 3 years have been an awful experience. I sold Toyota my old vehicle and it took almost a month to receive payment even though they demanded my payment immediately. 9 times out of 10, the website doesn't work to make payment. Calling in for Customer Service took around an hour to connect EVERY TIME. I am purchasing my vehicle direct now and they are taking an eternity to process payment and Customer Service has been awful to deal with.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.review_text: How does such a huge corporation not have a chat service on their website for customer support and how does such a huge corporation put you on hold for an ENTIRE hour just for a question you have. RIDICULOUS.

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.review_text: My car was recently repossessed by Toyota, this is one 100% my fault. No one to blame but myself without getting into. I fell on some hard times, anyways I need to pay the months I owe, ok. I saved that, then they add $870 repo fee, then $75 tow fee and $10 a day storage fee, and I have to make an appointment to pick my car back up, they will only take western union payments that are more ridiculous fees, I am a single mom trying to make. This company kicks you when you're down, it was pay some major bills for my kids or car payment. I had to do what I had to do, I now have the money to get the car and they make it impossible almost. Idk. Just really bad experience with this company. Stay away if you can.

reviews.author: April
reviews.review_text: The service from the dealership was great! The financial department through Toyota Financial is the worst! Do not get a loan through them. There are a few people besides myself having so many problems just processing payments through them. They will not take a payment no matter how many times I have called to clarify the info. They say it's paid and everything is good but if you're not looking closely you will find yourself 2 to 3 payments behind. Even though they tell you it all is good, if you're not checking well you won't be. Then you call again to get things fixed and find out what's going on, the people over the phone consider it a means to "collect a debt" making you feel like the bad person. The problem is still not resolved after three months of arguing and attempting to make payments. DO NOT TAKE LOANS FROM THEM!

reviews.author: Thuy
reviews.review_text: I would give 0 stars if possible. I paid off my car in December of 2023 in 2 transactions and received a confirmation email stating that "at this point, there's nothing more you need to do" and another email stating that my recurring payments have been canceled (I assume because I had already paid off the car). Then, I receive a check for $9 because I apparently had overpaid on the payoff quote. A couple months past and I receive a statement stating that my balance is overdue. After checking my online account, I see that my balance has not been paid off and that one transaction was reversed and the other one had failed. I was not made aware of this until the beginning of February of 2024 during which interest had been accruing. Had I known that my payments were actually not successful, I would paid immediately. After numerous attempts at getting a representative on the phone, I was told that I had to contact my bank to see why the transaction failed and that I had to pay the new payoff amount instead. After asking why they did not notify me that the payment failed, the rep said that they do not have to notify the customer if a payment failed. Toyota has withdrew money from my account multiple times with no problems because I have automatic withdrawals set up. I don't get why this time there is a problem. After going back and forth with the rep, I asked to speak to a supervisor. The rep told me that a supervisor would call me in 24-48 hours and asked for the best contact number. As I am writing this review a week later, I still have not received a call from a supervisor. While waiting for the call from a supervisor, robocalls from Toyota would call me multiple times a day reminding me about the late payments. When I contacted customer service through the online portal and asked for a supervisor email, I was told to call another customer service number. I have decided to pay the new payoff amount so that I can be free of Toyota Financial Services. This is my first and last time doing business with them.

reviews.author: Donald
reviews.review_text: We paid our 2017 Toyota Rav 4 off in November 2023. It is February, and after 20 calls to discuss with numerous levels, still no title. They lie, everyone tells you what you want to hear, and to date we still don't have our title. I thought they had to send the title out within 30 days??? If we would have ever been late on a payment, (which we never were), I guarantee they would not listen to our excuses. This is the most pathetic Company I have ever dealt with. I will Never buy another Toyota due to their incompetence, and I had been a customer since 1975.

reviews.author: Dennis
reviews.review_text: Tried logging in and every time I do I instantly get a 'verification code sent to your email' notification. Happened several times and when I enter code it then asks if I want to remember my device but THERE IS NO 'YES' ICON to press! So I'm staring at a box that asks a question but provides no way of answering! UNACCEPTABLE!

reviews.author: Sherry
reviews.review_text: They would call me more then 4 times a day. I answer then they hang up. Now they called me saying I owe and said they will get my car. Said to her, "Are you kidding me!! Heck no." Said, "Touch this car and I will take Toyota Financial to court." So ready to get away from this place. Worst place to have a car finance. They have no respect for elder, they are rude and don't care.

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.review_text: We have a loan with TFS. I made a payment online and we started getting calls about a late payment... Turns out their system "reversed" our payment. The problem was, they withdrew the money from our account but did not credit it back (per the reversal). Now they say we are behind, but they still have that payment. We have called and called to clear the problem, have faxed bank statements and have received no confirmation of receipt and when we have called there is no record of our fax. When I spoke with one rep on the phone he directed me to the online customer service to enter the documents through our portal but the customer service section of the site didn't work then and has not worked in the weeks since this ordeal began. If I could give negative stars I would. There is no way to talk to anyone who has skill or knowledge. They are holding a large sum of our money saying it is our burden to prove we paid. However, Toyota is a business who has business protocol. They could run a reconciliation report and pretty easily find that reversal never left their heftily lined pockets. I regret using TFS. It feels like doing business with the mob. We feel powerless. Who can help us???

reviews.author: Dalila
reviews.review_text: I bought a Toyota CHR car with this company 5 years ago. I had automatic payments and now they reported my account as past due affecting my credit score. When I made the last payment they did not give me a confirmation number and I had to demand that they give it to me. Now I am waiting for the title and I don't know if it will arrive in the next 3 weeks. For me, they are shameless. They were charging me more than we owed. The customer service is terrible. They are very rude. This company never helped me build my credit in the 5 years I paid. I do not recommend this place to buy a car.

reviews.author: Martese
reviews.review_text: My husband traded in his Tundra that he got in TX in November to another Toyota dealer in Stone Mountain Ga when we moved. Toyota Financial continued to charge him for a truck that he traded in even though they were told many times we no longer had the vehicle and they paid the truck off. Toyota Financial called his job, our home and were told the same thing by us and when we called the dealer and talked to the finance guy at Stone Mountain Toyota to see what was going on they apparently called them also. Toyota financial said until they got the check which could take what they said 30 days which took 39 days they continued to tell us we were late on a truck we no longer had in our possession. I can see if it was a check from Ford to Toyota but it was Toyota to Toyota and they have the nerve to charge a late fee and some miscellaneous fee and until paid they won’t update the account. So there goes his credit! I’m so pissed I could spit nails at all of this unnecessary **

reviews.author: Ivan
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial required documents from me to process an insurance claim. However they gave the wrong information to me to obtain a document they requested. The Maintenance Auto Protection plan document they needed came from their own organization. That document was from their own Toyota Financial office at the auto dealer and not from the bank. The error caused a two month delay for my claim and $700 overpayment as a result. Terrible service. Terrible knowledge. Terrible business. Not recommended.

reviews.author: Nathan
reviews.review_text: I’ve been trying to receive my car title for 6 months from Toyota Financial. Twice they’ve sent all my documents to the wrong address. I’m now unable to register my car and my state doesn’t allow more than 2 temporary registration passes. If you call toyota for anything regarding your auto loan, they will purposely make things incredibly difficult. I do not recommend toyota financial services to anyone.

reviews.author: Kelsey
reviews.review_text: Jacob provided very poor customer service at 11:40 AM on October 30, 2023. He was very catty and rude for no reason. I called to ask about when my car payment was due and he was incredibly ill natured and snide. He should not work in customer service.

reviews.author: Donita
reviews.review_text: I called customer on October 18th, 2023. I had unfortunate accident that caused me to be out of work. I asked for deferred payment for this month due to being out of work due to an accident. The gentleman spoke with customer service tells me I’m approved but it will be my last one for the year. I unfortunately have had some unfortunate events this year. I told him I understood, he went through the whole process and that letter would be sent to my email and one by mail for me to sign send back. Same process as before. I never received the letter, so called customer service October, 24, 2023 to find out why have no received the letter and representative tells me I got DENIED!!! What is going on? How can you tell me I’m approved but then say DENIED. Needless to say between the stress of dealing with incompetent company and then having to deal with life altering injury has taken a toll. As large company Toyota is and you can train competent employees to do a job that’s very irresponsible!!!

reviews.author: DANAY
reviews.review_text: I been a Toyota customer for years, always purchased the gap insurance. And back in June I had and accident my car was total loss. My insurance pay the car, the remaining balance is been 3 months and Toyota don’t pay yet , I call all the time and is always excuses the check got lost or it takes time always something. I recommend don’t purchase this service with them. They are horrible.

reviews.author: johnny
reviews.review_text: In late 2018, I bought a Toyota Rav4 that was brand new and financed with Toyota Finance, but they didn’t give me my college rebate like many other customers because before signing the contact agreement I asked the loan officer, "I just graduated 9 months ago. Do I qualified for the rebate?" He said no because of the time frame but then I found that within 2 years so I qualified and I contacted him to rectify the agreement or give me my rebate but he denied to do so. Then I have contacted the dealership numerous times from the dealership salesman, sales manager, and Toyota corporate office, but they seemed to ignore my complaint that Toyota Corporate was blaming the dealership, and I just want to be fair to myself like others who got the rebate. I feel like they are enterprise scams.

reviews.author: Mikayla
reviews.review_text: IF ZERO ** STARS WERE AN OPTION!!! The ONLY reason they’re getting one is because it’s NOT. I had a payment of 170 dollars schedule to come out. My check was a little more than expected so I cancelled the payment and made a one-time payment of a little more. I cancelled both in the app AND calling them and received two TWO cancellation emails for doing so. They PROCEEDED to take BOTH payments out of my account. Even though they CONFIRMED to me it was cancelled. And now I can’t afford formula OR DIAPERS for my BABY. And they wanted to tell me, “I completely understand what it is you’re going through. Is there any friends or family you can reach out to for help? a shelter? a donation place” A SHELTER??? FOR A BABY??? HOW ABOUT YOU TECHNICALLY STOLE MY MONEY??? LITERALLY TOOK FOOD OUT OF MY CHILD'S MOUTH. HOW ABOUT YOU FIX IT. Do NOT lease with Toyota Financial Services. They’re crooks and thieves and do NOT care. I have PROOF of it being cancelled and they did it anyways. NEVER again.

I refinanced my Honda a few years back. Chase Bank sent them at check for the outstanding balance ($ 5,356.32) of my Honda that was soon to be refinanced by my credit Union. Toyota claimed they never got the check, however the check was cashed and endorsed by Toyota. Both, Chase Bank & myself fought with them and myself over this matter. Chase had to keep sending and resending the endorsed check to them but they still kept lying, saying they never got the check. Toyota then demanded I pay my next payment due which of course, was total **. Well, eventually they admitted they had been paid but didn't show the pay off on my account for 6 months making it harder to get any kind of loan since my credit report showed that the balance was still due and I had two separate auto loans. On the 2nd of August I sent them a money order from my credit Union for $1,000 on another Toyota car I recently bought. They again claimed they never got the check I sent c/o my credit union and now we're into September even though my credit union showed proof that the check was cashed by, Toyota. I have no other choice then to sue them which I will be doing shortly after this review. This is the 2nd time they attempted to stifle me. Don't get any auto loan with these clowns. End of story.

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.review_text: This organization is totally inept. 7 years after my loan was paid off and my lien was not released, despite their records showing that I had paid off the loan. I then requested a letter notifying me that the lien was release so that I could register my car in a new state and then sell it. The person on the phone said I would get a release letter overnighted to me and a FAX confirmation in two business days. Nothing showed up. I called again 4 days later and the person said it was really 7-10 business days. I told her I needed the FAX sent NOW as I sat in a FedEx office, waiting for it. She put me on hold for half an hour as she escalated and then said I would receive the FAX by the end of the day. I told her as I am telling you that this is unacceptable. Toyota Financial is a terrible, terrible organization. Toyota is also going steeply downhill. Go anywhere else!!!

reviews.author: Valentin
reviews.review_text: I bought a new Toyota Grand highlander and I have been stuck of not able to pay via the website. I raised more than dozens of tickets with the IT department via the Customer service line. All the replies I got were that they don't see any issues of process the payments via the website. I can't, I simply can't as when I try to add my bank account info or process the payment, I got returned to the Dashboard. In the past 4 weeks, I talked with more than 10 people and no solution so far. I can't believe that nowadays such an issue can stay for so long and not get resolved. It's really killing the moment of enjoying the new car. For the record, I bought another Toyota few years ago and I had the same issues, but they were resolved within 3 days. Now is terrible.

reviews.author: David
reviews.review_text: 2 years I’ve paid on my Toyota. Now I sent in a 915.00 money order. It was cashed by them and I have proof. I send in my money order the same way every single time. This time they cashed it and did not apply it to my account so now I’m out 915.00. I’ve talked to probably 5 people in 3 days. Horrible company. Will never purchase a Toyota again.

reviews.author: Isabelle
reviews.review_text: I had to call FOUR times!!! NONE of them said the same thing to me. The first one told me to contact my bank so I did and they could not do what the customer service woman said. The second guy did NOT know what he was doing, wasted my time. The third person claimed I needed proof of payment from my bank. No, I do not. The proof is LITERALLY on their end that I paid my bill. Then she hung up on me. Finally, the last person could actually assist me.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.review_text: Something is definitely wrong with their online payment system. I was a new customer, made my first payment before it was due. Had confirmation number. Two weeks later the payment reversed. It happened 2 times. Then I made a double payment. All of the information is correct. They called my work place. Unreal!!

reviews.author: Max
reviews.review_text: I hate this company. I got Toyota Tacoma with finance. My car was totalled, Toyota stole my car from the towing company and isn't giving it to insurance company for to get approved it's totaled and wanted to keep paying for the car.

reviews.author: Brittany
reviews.review_text: I purchased a vehicle from Toyota and financed with Toyota Financial to purchase the car. I have never had such a miserable experience with a company in my life. Not only do they not listen to the customer who makes the monthly payments and whose name is on the loan. They also ignore your requests about documents being sent to a specific address on the account. They screwed me out of a total of $611.57 and sent that money elsewhere and say there is nothing they can do to retrieve that money back or stop the checks. I will NEVER do business with Toyota Financial again and DO NOT recommend them to anyone. 10/10 NEVER DO BUSINESS WITH TOYOTA FINANCIAL. Unless you like losing money and having a company that finances you for over 40k ignore your requests. I would give negative stars if it was possible.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.review_text: I purchased a Vehicle Service Agreement when I bought my 2023 Toyota the end of April; however, I cancelled it the end of June. I was told the refund would be applied to my loan. This was acceptable even though I paid cash for the Agreement. The vehicle was refinanced on July 21st although Toyota Financial didn't record it until July 25th (today I was informed it was recorded on the 26th???). I received a letter dated July 27th stating that the Agreement refund was applied to my loan. As the loan was already at zero, I called to find out where my money was and was told I should receive it in about two weeks. I have had Toyota vehicles for many years and will continue to enjoy them, however, I will not deal with Toyota Financial in the future and advise others to think twice or three times before dealing with them.

reviews.author: Kristen
reviews.review_text: I have been financing with them for over 6 years. No issues up until the past two years. I had moved states and needed to get new tags. I sent in all the necessary paperwork and received nothing. This has gone on for TWO YEARS. Now my tags are long expired and I have yet to receive any paperwork, answers, or remedies about the situation. Each time I call, I get a different answer for the holdup. Each time I call I am told they are sending me paperwork via mail, never received anything. I will NEVER use this company again, nor will I recommend them. Clearly customer loyalty and perfect on time payments does NOT payoff.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.review_text: After being a loyal Toyota patron for 18 year and leased and purchased 6 vehicles. They judge me the Covid time of late payment. And refused to finance a leases payout that was way less than the value.

reviews.author: Geoffrey
reviews.review_text: I bought out my lease over 2 months ago. Since then, I cannot overstate the amount of errors and incompetency on Toyota Financial Services' part. Mailing the title to the wrong address MULTIPLE times. Not including the bill of sale when they finally sent it to the correct one. With all the calls to customer service and today's failed trip to the RMV (couldn't register without bill of sale), this lease buyout process has cost me well over 20 hours of my life. It's unfortunate, because I love the car, but I will never be able to buy another Toyota again because of this experience. Cannot state emphatically enough - avoid working with this company at all costs.

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.review_text: The errors that are on their part are NUMEROUS. They have had my complete payoff for many weeks and I still have no title, no bill of sale and NO HELP!!! You can't get through to anyone with any authority to help, they can only send an email to probably nobody - which they have and guess what? NOBODY answered! It has been a MONTH. I have been avoiding the police since, and because of Toyota Financial, I am driving around on expired tags! The dealership can't seem to help either - and was fairly unresponsive, but the corporate Toyota Financial is the real incompetent entity. REALLY REALLY BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE.

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.review_text: I traded in my vehicle last year due to divorce. My old car was in my ex-husband’s name. We went to Reliable Toyota in Springfield MO to get me a vehicle. They tried their best to get me trapped with a high interest and not worth it for the price. I tried to get an older vehicle that I can afford but they said due to my equity it was better to get a newer car so I ended up getting the 2019 Jeep Cherokee Trailhawk for the amount of $25,000 value but I’m paying $781/month for 72months for 10 % interest with their protection plan (**). That’s a total ripped-off!!! Lesson learned. No matter how hard the situation is never go to TOYOTA anymore!

reviews.author: Thelma
reviews.review_text: We bought a car from Toyota dealership through Toyota Financial services. The customer service does not follow up with what they told us they gonna do. This company double charge our account in December 2022 and we requested refund when we found out about it, but we never receive our refund check. On February 24th we requested to apply our refund to the month of February since our autopay did not happen for the month of February 2023 because we happened to change our bank account in their system not knowing that the auto pay will be affected. One month after we requested to apply our refund to the February charge, this company never applied the refund and charge us late fee while they already have our refund money and up to this time they never applied the refund to our account.

reviews.author: Melisa
reviews.review_text: My husband and I purchased a car with Toyota Financial. During the pandemic and due to hardship we had to defer some payments. We were always told that the payments would be differed to extend the end of the contract. We maintained great payment history and did not have any payments past due. In February of 2023 we made a double payment. In March we made our regular payment as well as a payoff payment. On March 31st I received a call saying our account was past due. The agent did not know how to explain to me how it was past due. She even said it had to be an error. When I hung up with her, I checked my credit report and payment history was marked as on time in February and all months prior to that for the duration of the account. I called back to see what is going on because we were in the process of buying a home. When the second agent spoke to me she was very rude and said that the contract was due to expire in April and that April was the final month payment was due in full. I asked how could that be and she stated that all differed payments needed to be paid in April upon closure of the contract and that the deferred payments were now being reported as past due. We had one month left on our contract. I lost my mind and asked if the differed payments were past due, why were we marked as paid on time for February she stated that as long as we paid by April 15th we would not be reported as derogatory. I asked for the pay off balance. She gave it to me and rudely hung up. I went online and posted the payoff amount quoted. This took place at 9am. Obviously well before the cut off time. They delayed processing the payment for a few days and then sent us a letter stating we still owed 76 dollars and that due to this we will be reported derogatory and repossession would be done if not paid in full by 4/15. I called back again and asked how could this be when we paid what was quoted and the new agent was very nice, reviewed my account and said she was going to read the last agent notes. Last agent was not only rude. But lied and said she had spoke with my husband. My husband is not available to speak to anyone due to his line of work and I handle all calls. Agent told me that I was obviously misquoted and that we in fact were already reported as derogatory and that she could obviously see that we had in fact made payments on time as well as double payments for February and March and had even attempted to settle the account in full. The letter stated we had until April 15th before negative reports would incur. We paid the car off 3/31 and they still reported us derogatory. Then they said I had to pay the remainder 76 dollars. I gave her the payment. She said she felt bad, she would speak to the resolutions manager to see if they would help remove the derogatory mark because obviously we were making several payments within weeks of each of them, and when she came back she said her resolutions manager said she could not and would not help me. The account was officially closed and that I needed to dispute it with the credit department. My credit is ruined as well as my husband's. We don't even know if we can still purchase a home as planned. Toyota financial are thieves, liars and they have incompetent staff. We will never finance again with Toyota and I warn others to stay away from them. They purposely delay payment processing to keep collecting interest on the accounts and they do not abide by what they send in writing. I would give them no stars if I could.

reviews.author: Zaira
reviews.review_text: I recently purchased a vehicle and Toyota Financial provided me with a credit limit for my downpayment of $2,500. Even though payments were made 2 days prior due date the company would take the payment 5 days after due date in order for them to charge you late fees no matter what. They charged me twice in one month which overdrafted my bank account and they took no responsibility over it. Then they said I was on a 6 month promotional plan and the time was up and they charged me $ 445 plus of interest which I called to put in full and get rid of this company to my surprise the following month I received another charge of $41 something as if the $445 wasn’t enough!!!! This company steals your money DONT TRUST THEM!!!

reviews.author: Youssef
reviews.review_text: I called to have my lease extended as we aren't able to get vehicle we want at this time. The Agent went ahead and extended our lease for 6 months. The idiot didn't tell me they were going to remove my banking information from the account and that the auto payments setup for the last 36 months would stop. I didn't notice the payment didn't come out of my bank until I got an alert from credit agency that Toyota Financial reported I was 30 days late. I immediately made payment and setup autopay again but they will not remove the 30 day late off my credit.

reviews.author: Pure
reviews.review_text: This is the worse company I have ever dealt with in my life. After 6 years of leasing a car, I asked for three extensions throughout the years. None of them got put in correctly. One agent said they mailed me the paperwork to sign, which was incorrect, I never got any paperwork. Another agent said, "You don't need to sign." It has been an exhausting nightmare with these guys. Every time you get on the phone with them they tell you something different. Now at the end of my lease, they forget to put the extension in the system so my payments are reported as late. May the Lord rebuke them.

reviews.author: Eric
reviews.review_text: I never missed a payment. At the end of my lease I was to get a refund for overpayment cause my wife pay and the auto payment as well $420. I want the money asap. They made me wait. I called weeks before the lease end. I called and was told three times some would get back to me. They never paid me. I knew it. Scammers. Never buy anything from Toyota. Never missed a payment to them. When it came time to pay me. Nothing.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.review_text: I never missed a payment. At the end of my lease I was to get a refund for dent and tire insurance. $860. I never agreed to this. I want the money asap. They made me wait. I called weeks before the lease end. I called and was told twice some would get back to me. They never paid me. I knew it. Scammers. Never buy anything from Toyota. Never missed a payment to them. When it came time to pay me. Nothing.

reviews.author: Francis
reviews.review_text: Have an account with Toyota Financial Services (2022 Toyota) and upon calling Customer "Service" at 18008748822 REPEATEDLY OVER SEVERAL DAY, still can't get them to pick up the phones to help resolve an issue with a payment I made. Their phone system is set up to DROP YOU if you attempt to contact an operator, ask a question, need help, etc. and all you get is their awful (limited) automated response system.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.review_text: I moved between states, and Toyota Financial Services has been incredibly slow and unhelpful in transferring my vehicle's title to the new state. I first called at the beginning of August to inform of my move, but it was not until September that they put in the request to the original state to have a title produced. They do not follow up with me at all, I have to call every week to see the status of my request.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.review_text: I called TFS multiple times throughout the span of a month to try and get a specific document that I need to register my car after I had moved out of state. They never gave me a straight answer and lied to me about sending it out. Every time I called someone had a different response and no one would answer my questions with a simple answer. After this lease, I won’t be working with Toyota again.

reviews.author: Nalin
reviews.review_text: When I purchased my new Toyota from Arlington Toyota in Jacksonville FL in early Sep/2002, the dealer did not say which lender would provide the auto loan. Unfortunately Toyota Financial Services was assigned. I was told there will be no pre-payment penalties by the dealer. Well, it turns-out that this financial company runs a scam to still charge interest from me when I make extra payments towards the loan principal. What they do is move-out the date when the payment is due so that additional interest has to be paid by me. So, next payment was due on Oct/11/2022. When I made a $1000 payment towards the loan principal, they moved-out my auto payment date by a month to Nov/11/2022. This payment I made before any payment was due. I've been on the phone several times to get the next autopayment processed as scheduled, but they won't actually do it. The customer service lies and says they updated the payment date, but when I look at the details on the website, they haven't updated anything. I don't know what to do or whom to reach-out to at this time to stop them from overcharging interest from me. Maybe the only thing I could do is re-finance the loan with a reputable bank. If you are buying a new Toyota from a dealership, please have your own finance in place, do not get a loan arranged by the Toyota dealership.

reviews.author: T. D.
reviews.review_text: Do not care about disabled customers. I have made payments on time for years. I became permanently disabled a few months ago, and I am waiting for insurance to start paying out. They said nothing they could do because my loan was near the maturity date. No extensions, nothing. What a low-life-sucking financial company. I am selling my new Toyota and changing manufacturers.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.review_text: I bought a car thru McCall Toyota, and Toyota Financial handles the payments, I was late on a few payments. Instead of a $50 late fee, these morons take $790 from 2 car payments of $400… ridiculous, they are definitely thieves. Don’t ever do business with these white collar crooks. They should be locked up and thrown in jail…. because of their practices.. They took $790 and put it towards interest, and $10.92 towards principal, I made 2 payments on the car… These people are nuts…

reviews.author: Dennis
reviews.review_text: Unacceptable response from entire team. Trying to get a title for 4 months. Loss of unit depreciation and Michael ** promised to call back after a 2.5 hour phone call. That was the last of many hours on the phone. He recommended I sue the dealer who leased the vehicle to me, laughed at me, yawned and said I was ridiculous request waiting 4 months for a title that the dealer wants to return the unit. Again, Michael ** assure me he would run this up the Ladder that as a dealer we are looking for a complete buyout or unit depreciation and failed to live up to his promise. Did I mention Michael ** Supervisor from Toyota Financial promised he would deal with this swiftly?

reviews.author: Grene
reviews.review_text: Horrible! Had my car leasing with them. I never missed a payment. When I had an accident and car was totaled my insurance company paid them immediately (less than one month!). However I had overpaid a bit my loan and they owed me a check of a few thousand dollars. That check never arrived!!!! Interesting how their bills arrived but my check (my money!) never arrived! DO NOT WORK WITH THEM - there are many respectable and professional loan companies available. They lied to me SEVERAL TIMES on the phone - that they mailed the check, that check is coming with FedEx, that they will call me back with a tracking number, etc. Never received anything from them and did not receive a tracking number either. Next step is the court.

reviews.author: Sheila
reviews.review_text: They keep stating that my payments are always late and it’s going on my credit report. They are rip offs and after this vehicle is paid off I will never deal with TOYOTA FINANCIAL SERVICES AGAIN. They are THIEVES!

reviews.author: A
reviews.review_text: They do not release your lien after you pay in full. They do not ensure you receive your title. They hang up on you if you call and close your ticket if you submit a help desk ticket. They say it is your problem if you do not receive your title. Do not buy a Toyota unless you can pay in full. If you borrow from Toyota Financial Corp, you will never own your own vehicle. This company is a scam and very unethical in their practices.

reviews.author: Russell
reviews.review_text: I tried to make a payment over the phone before my automatic payment was due but I didn’t do it in time. Then I was charged twice for the same month. I contacted customer service three separate times explaining the situation. The customer service representatives I spoke with were very knowledgeable and friendly. They returned my money but it took nine days to get my money back with snail mail. Why is it that electronic payments happen in two days but it takes ten days to refund your money? I’ve been in the same situation with credit card companies and they refunded my money instantly.

reviews.author: Will
reviews.review_text: I'm a current customer of Toyota Financial Services for almost 4 years. I've made my payments on time and many times even before they are due. Over 10 times I've sent in my payment and had to resend it because they were too dumb to credit it to my account even though my name in my account number was on the money order. I was going to pay my car off early but this time these dodoes cashed my money order and didn't credit it to my account. I sent in a copy of the money as proof with their stamp on it and they still didn't credit it to my account cuz they said they have to find out where the funds went. That's not my problem. They cashed my money order they need to credit the $330.00 to my account and whatever they did with the money is their headache not mine. I did my part. To top it off they reported me as being late for their indiscrepancies! Sometimes there is only 1 way to say something and bottom line is these people are mind numbingly stupid except for Cynthia. I would advise anyone who reads this not to do business with Toyota financial services or any business affiliated with Toyota. IT'S NOT WORTH THE HEADACHE!

reviews.author: Satar
reviews.review_text: They do not release titles for loan payoffs until you call them many, many times. They have a problem internally processing loan payoffs. They will NOT simply send you title once you finally pay off their Toyota Motor Credit or Toyota Lease loan. You will have to call them over and over to finally receive it. This is illegal as you are unable to sell, transfer, refinance your vehicle without 1) the title or 2) a lien satisfied. It will take a group of us to form class action to get these ** and change their negligence. You will find my complaint is common with Toyota Financial.

reviews.author: Dhruvit
reviews.review_text: Worst service. Overall bad experience with no transparency. It's always hard to get proper answer. Once you pay off, you need to wait for title release for a long period of time. And if you asked them they will not resent the copy of the title but the lean release so you need to go to BMV and get the title. And it all takes more than 15 days to get your mail as they are mailing important document in regular mail without tracking number. None of the representative have proper answer.

reviews.author: Melissa
reviews.review_text: I am absolutely sick to my stomach over the way Toyota Financial Services treated me today. I had a very serious situation today over the numerous phone calls Toyota makes to my phone on a daily basis. And had been complaining about it since last year and the customer service agents assured me it would be taken care of. Instead they outright lied to me. Nothing was handled and I paid the ultimate price for it. Which is unemployment. When I called Toyota they kept passing me around to different managers and wrote things on my account that was never even discussed. And in finally the last manager I spoke to blamed me for my situation. This company is dishonest and I highly recommend for people to run the other way. They treat you like gold until they get your signature on the paperwork then you become nothing to them. I am absolutely shocked that they had the nerve to blame me for something they caused and did to me. Customer service agents write whatever they want on your account and there is nothing you can do about it. Horrible company. Save your self the stress and go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.review_text: I just want to check with them when will the extended warranty of my car be expired, I have called them so many times since morning until now, almost 5pm, only the receptionist answered my call. And the answers gave to me were “They are busy, they will call you back.” Is it so difficult to return a call? Only worked effectively when they want me to buy their extended warranty!

reviews.author: Ruth
reviews.review_text: I paid this car off and the payoff amount was posted to my account on February 7th and my account showed that it was closed. Then on February 10th they took the car payment amount out of my bank account. I called customer service and the representative said the computer system hadn't "caught up yet." I asked her to refund the money to my account and she said the only way they could give me my money back was by sending out a paper check and that it won't even be processed until February 20th. This wasn't my fault, they took money out of my account after my car loan was paid and the account was CLOSED and now I have to wait several weeks to see a paper check in the mail. I won't be doing business with them again.

reviews.author: LA BELLA
reviews.review_text: Called Toyota Financial Services on 2-4-2022 at 10:11 am. Rep. Dian without an ID number from the moment she pick up the call had the WORSE attitude. Was extremely RUDE. She did not want to listen nor hear to what I had to say. If a customer is calling to get information it should not matter what time or day. All employees representing Toyota Financial, Toyota or any company under Toyota should be PLEASANT, GENTLE, MILD SPEAKING MANNER. Ms. DIAN WAS NOT THAT PERSON.

reviews.author: Lilly
reviews.review_text: I called Toyota Financial to make my scheduled payment on the 5th of every month (mind you that on the app and website I’m using to do autopay is set up for the 5th of every month but it’s pulling out every 27th). The representative said that he can’t do anything on his side because the app and websites are set up for self service, and that he has no access to viewing or changing my information. Now I’m thinking… Why does this Number exists if you can’t even help me or any caller? If they wanted me to find it out on my on they should have not supplied a contact line. Don’t waste your time calling with these people. They must be make good money by sitting on the butts and detouring loyal paying customers away.

reviews.author: Eleonora
reviews.review_text: Absolutely not helpful. Company's mistake resulted in my score dropping 80 points after I have been told it would not affect my score. When I called for explanation and them to fix it got no help and no acknowledgement of their mistakes. They were just saying same phrase on a loop. To be treated like that repeatedly in 2022 is absolutely unacceptable.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.review_text: Never again. Spent too many hours to count, on hold, calling my bank, lies and more lies, 4 months of phone calls, trying to pay my loan off. Saying electronically cashed checks didn't clear when I've got tracing #, the account of theirs, everything to prove payment but the check itself which they ask for knowing that they keep the checks and my bank does not get them back. Asking for merchant reports from my bank to fax them, my bank never heard of this. Then called back to find out now my account shows it posted. Please never use Toyota Financial. You'll be sorry. The whole system is messed up. Workers there must hate their jobs, they lie all the time, only a few will actually do their jobs.

reviews.author: Marco
reviews.review_text: Spoke with Toyota customer service so called Supervisor, regarding a mistake. They processed to be incorrect with my payment my money & called to correct it & all they can say is, "We are terribly sorry. We cannot do anything to correct it." In other words telling me too bad..

reviews.author: Mohamed
reviews.review_text: I had to write about my bad experience with Toyota, In August 2021 I did lease a vehicle under swap lease and until now I'm paying for a car that I can't drive because of The lack of service with paperwork!!

reviews.author: Barry
reviews.review_text: August 11 I sent a check for $9400 to pay off my RAV4 EV loan. That plus a $440 check that followed was in excess of what was owed. I heard nothing back waiting for a check and title. I called a few weeks later and found they had misapplied the funds. They misread the account number. Fine, they promised in a few days it would be fixed and I would get my title and check. Today after hearing nothing, I called and got some idiot who found all the records and unable to explain why the problem existed. He said they would have to sit on the funds for 10 days (funds that were cashiers checks weeks ago) and then in a month or two resolve it!!!! (If I am selling my car how does THAT work???) SO I get a resolutions person on the phone who says they will have information for me in 3-5 business days! WTF? What if I had failed a payment? I bet they act faster. They just do not care at all that they continue to screw up and I am left waiting for my pink slip!

reviews.author: C
reviews.review_text: Some advice: Do not finance your vehicle through Toyota Financial Services. Go through a local credit union or another institution you trust. Here's my story - in June of 2021 I began the process of buying out a lease. With used car prices spiking, it was a great time to purchase and resell, so I was eager to get through the process quickly. I called and spoke to a representative (after being on hold forever, as others have mentioned), who told me the payoff amount verbally and instructed me to just "pay it through the online portal and we'll send you the title." I should've realized that it was bizarre to send >$30k into the ether for a $400 monthly lease payment without any further information, but I did as instructed and waited... and waited... and got nothing. No email, no message, no title in the mail. After weeks, I called again and was told I'd be on hold for 90 minutes, so instead I sent a message through the online portal. After a few days, I got a response contradicting what I had been told on the phone. Not only was the amount they originally asked for incorrect (didn't include sales tax), but I would need to fill out a form and send payment via cashier's check instead of a digital payment. Meanwhile, the $30k I had already sent digitally was mysteriously marked as "credited" back to me, despite never actually being returned to my bank account. After asking for clarification, the rep sent me a digital payoff form and told me I would just have to send the difference (sales tax) as a cashier's check, and mail that along with the form. The amount "credited" would be applied towards the purchase, despite being supposedly the "wrong" way to pay. They then closed the online help ticket. I again did as instructed, but called again to check whether I would really need to send the sales tax by cashier's check. This time, after being on hold forever again, a different rep said I could just use the online portal to pay... contradicting the last rep... again. Wary now, I triple-checked, but they insisted it would be fine. So I sent the payment online and waited. After a couple more weeks (it's now late August 2021, so much for a quick turnaround), I received a letter saying my account had been sent to collections for "defaulting" on two lease payments (~$800), despite the fact that I had now sent them nearly $35k online to buy the rest of the lease and vehicle! Yes, I agree, it defies reason! I have now sent them yet another support request online seeking clarification after waiting 90 minutes on hold to no avail. It is truly baffling how hard Toyota has made it for me to purchase a vehicle. They are now holding an enormous amount of money ransom, while simultaneously claiming my account is somehow in default, and otherwise stonewalling me. They should absolutely be investigated for their incompetence, breach of contract, and borderline theft. Avoid these clowns at all costs!

reviews.author: MJ
reviews.review_text: I love my car but will refinance as soon as possible because I cannot deal with shady businesses. -The monthly “statement” they send gives no breakdown of where the payment is applied. As a consumer you have no idea what was applied toward principal or interest unless you call. After spending 48 minutes on hold I was told there is no more detailed statement you can request and if you want a breakdown you have to call for it. -You cannot pay any extra each month and have it apply toward principal. When I called to request this after realizing they were applying my extra funds to future payments I was given a recorded message explaining the 3 manual ways principal payments can be made. -When I asked for the upcoming payment and how much of that is principal VS. interest they hung up on me. -The service person talked over me during the entire call. It was unacceptable. It was clear she had an agenda to follow and there is nothing service oriented about how she handled my questions. This is easily the worst customer service in the business. Huge fail.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.review_text: It took TF two weeks to process my lease end payoff. Despite nearly daily calls to their "customer service" reps, they never sped things up. I gave them my express mail acct, but they sent title by snail mail.

reviews.author: Erik
reviews.review_text: You would think that after paying off a car, the title would soon follow. This is not the case with me. Long story short, I paid off my car 2.5 years ago. I have a letter from Toyota stating that vehicle was paid in full. The only problem is they have not sent the DMV or me the certificate of lien release. When I called the DMV, they said it is electronic and they can't send me title without Toyota sending them the certificate of lien release. Of course when I try to call Toyota, there is a long hold. I can't wait 3 hours to talk to a person. Why they don't have a call back system for long waits such as 3 hours, is beyond me. Further, why is it on me to prompt them to do their part? Toyota, great cars, poor financial management department.

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.review_text: I’ve been calling for over two hours, I traded in my vehicle and the dealership wants me to call Toyota Financial Services to let them know since payment is due next week. But no one is answering the damn phone. And it’s been over two hours. What the hell is going over there that they can’t answer the phone. This is ridiculous, when I first call I get the automated system. I go thru all these steps to get a real person just so knows answer the phone and then get lit on hold for over two hours. This is not right. Someone needs to step in and throw down the hammer.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.review_text: As everyone knows there is a CURRENT global pandemic. I am a Toyota customer and was directly affected. Besides losing my job, I also contracted Covid in 2020. When you have Covid, you can’t go to work until you test negative. This can take several weeks. I spoke to Toyota Financial and asked to make a payment arrangement as I was not working due to the pandemic. They agreed. Little did I know they were going to destroy my hood credit by saying my payment (which was part of an agreement) was late. At the time I made the arrangement, they also didn’t tell me that I can make a partial payment, and this would be ok! They put me through a long tedious process of submitting disputes in writing, which I sent certified ($$). Then asked to RE-submit by fax ($). And then call and call desperately trying to navigate the broken IVR (the voice that asks you describe your issue in 3 words or less, but never understands) for weeks and retell every person about your crappy 2020, just to be told to call back. This company is deceptive. And I guess most companies that make money off regular people are. But to tell me “We provided courtesy removals DURING the pandemic, but this is outside of that window” is a slap in the face to someone who actually had the virus. The pandemic isn’t over. You should be more consistent and considerate with the global situation. (Steps off soapbox)

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.review_text: Trust me. Just don’t use autodraft through this company! My local water provider does a better job..., Very disappointed since I love Toyota trucks & cars so much. Shouldn’t have the Toyota named attached to this service!!

reviews.author: Armin
reviews.review_text: I have been keeping a log of the poor service that is provided by Toyota Financial Services. Let's begin with the poor runaround telephone automated system they use. After waiting periods of a stated 21 minutes or 41 minutes I still waited longer. You may ask why did I wait, it is because they applied my final payoff amount of $4,229.72 to another account or could not figure out where they applied the funds. My check to Toyota was sent to Toyota at the end of January 2021 and paid by my bank on Feb. 4, 2021 but they sent me a bill at the end of Feb. for the February payment. That's when I knew something was wrong. I have called them 6 -8 times speaking to various representatives who know very little or place you on hold and don't come back. I had to send them a 9 page fax outlining all my efforts, copies of the bank statement and check, copies of the payoff notice and statement. I requested that someone call me with follow up info that day. I waited a day and NO call or follow-up. I had to call again and ask for the number or supervisor who is handling my account. When calling the "RESOLUTION DEPARTMENT" today the rep "wanted to know how I got this number." He went on to say notation was made and still being processed. If they want their money I expect the service I paid for. Never again will I involve myself with Toyota.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.review_text: So what you will learn about Toyota is if you're late two or three months but pay on time for the current month they will put that payment towards a late month and report that you have not made a payment for the current month and charge you late fees and mess up your credit. Even if you request said payment go toward that current month, they'll still screw you over and tax on bunch of late fees making it impossible to catch up. I pay another car and they report a month missing if you miss a payment but report any payment for the current month Southland credit Union great financing company. What Toyota is doing is false reporting and fraud. Be careful.

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.review_text: I recently moved from FL to Long Island NY. I needed to register My 2017 Toyota Tacoma. I first called Toyota Customer for instruction. I was told to utilize a standard Toyota letter to present to NY DMV for registration. DMV rejected this. They informed me I needed a “certified copy of the title” & a letter of authorization to register my Toyota in NY. I called Toyota customer service & was told they would email a copy of the Certified Title directly to the local DMV. Try also promised to send the letter authorization letter to register my vehicle to my new address. I asked to have it mailed overnight. The rep told me he was not authorized to do this unless I could produce a UPS or FedX account number. I asked him to email a copy of the letter to me. He promised to both things. He did neither!!! I called customer service the next day & basically was told it was not done & the correct procedure was not followed. I reminded her I followed the procedure they told me. I asked to speak to a supervisor & was told the rep needed to “email” the supervisor with a request to call me. I stated this was unacceptable. They told me I was being transferred to the “dispute resolution” department. After being on hold for approximately 20 to 30 minutes I hung up. I tried again the third day & was told a new story.! They told me NYDMV needed to request the “Certified Copy of the Title directly from Toyota. I went to DMV with this information & was politely they do not do this. I asked again to be transferred to the dispute resolution department. After 30 minutes I hung up. The first rep gave me bad information. The reps day 2 & 3 were rude & frankly dishonest. Toyota makes a great product but Toyota Financial needs to understand the customer matters. As I write this my issues are not resolved. Tom **

reviews.author: Sarabeth
reviews.review_text: I have never had so many issues with one comapny as I have with Toyota Financial. In addition to being told different things by different representatives the representatives are really awful to deal with. If you have any type of complaint you can forget getting any help. They are very defensive about their practices and never accept responsibility. They have been terrible to deal with during the pandemic. The deferral process was a nightmare. Then I made an error by not returning a form even though they had told me my deferral was in place so who is expecting a next step but there was and I missed it and now I have been fined by them and had my credit destroyed. I am looking to turn in this lease to a different company. I want to be rid of Toyota for good.

reviews.author: Karissa
reviews.review_text: Unfortunately, I had high hopes for Toyota Financial. I figured with their reliable vehicles they would also be a reliable finance company. Wow was I wrong. They denied all covid extensions I needed. My cars got repoed and they threatened to keep my personal belongings. They told the repo yard to not give me my belongings. I had to get the police involved in which the repo yard then allowed me to get my property. Toyota agent kept telling me “I don’t care about what the police says it’s our policy” as if their policy is higher than the law. Very sad. I’m only 19 years old by the way and they approved me for 150k worth of auto loans and my Each of my vehicle payments Were over $800 a month. I will never be financing a vehicle again due to my experience

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.review_text: After paying off my 2009 Camry, I noticed inaccurate late payments had been applied to my credit profile. I submitted multiple disputes, and to no avail, each inquiry would result in more fraudulent and fictitious late payments reported being reported to the credit bureaus. To get this situation remedied and/or resolved, I submitted one final dispute on 12/22/2019. The results of the investigation rendered a delinquent status being applied to my paid off account in full. These retaliatory and predatory lending practices has negatively affected my credit worthiness, and quality of life. As a former loyal customer, I demand a amicable resolution, as I've purchased 2 vehicles from Toyota. I no longer believe Toyota's products, the customer service is horrendous, and the lending practices are unethical. I will never do business with another Toyota establishment again. I've received several invitations and pre-approvals to purchase another vehicle from Toyota. I am not interested. This company needs to be investigated.

reviews.author: Nathan
reviews.review_text: Inept customer service cost me money, time, and stress. Two times SETF sent notification letters to me AFTER a due date. First I was sent a notification that I needed to complete a Lessee Affidavit swearing that my vehicle is for personal use only, not business use. They mailed this notification after the due date for the form. I ended being taxed by my county, which cost me over $1000. The second feat of incompetence came recently, when my car is nearing the end of its lease. I was sent a notification that I’d be contacted by AutoVin for the turn in inspection, around 60 days before the end of my lease. I never got a call from AutoVin and this SETF notice was mailed to me past that time frame and leading into the Christmas/New Year holidays. I wasn’t able to talk with anyone at SETF (after waiting for multiple 1 hour hold times). So now my lease is coming to an end (two weeks), I need to get a new car, and I’m just now getting an appointment with AutoVin (whom I had to call). Terrible and incompetent company. I wouldn’t be surprised if they mail these notifications late to try to get late fees from people.

reviews.author: Karriem
reviews.review_text: No direct number to live support.. In order to speak to a person you have to blindly wade through an automated labyrinth with no logical rhyme or reason.. Next, you have to deal with people that know very little except how to receive a payment...!!!

reviews.author: ibrahim
reviews.review_text: Toyota finance did not accept to give me extensions during the coronavirus when I lost my job due to covid 19 and they repo my car while most of the banks give a lot of extensions to their customers, it’s seem to me they making money when they repo the car because I paid 3 years out of my auto loan so all interest rate it’s been paid so if they repo my car they will make the rest of the money right away without waiting for the next 3 years payment on my car, they are such a greedy people who have this policy against their customers. And the customer service so rude if you don’t speak their Alabama accent then they will treat you so bad over the phone and you are not consider to be a human being on the situation we have in our country because they will take advantage on you no matter what’s going on with the coronavirus.

reviews.author: robert
reviews.review_text: Purchased my 4Runner in Sept. Agreed to "finance" for the $750 military credit. Finally received my notice for payments and website directions. Went to the website to pay off the car. None of the buttons work. All come back as "We are experiencing difficulty. Try back later". So, I try over a week to give them a chance. No joy! So, I use the phone system to obtain my payoff balance and submit that through the website. Get an email noting the payment and that it had been received. However, no evidence on the account online that any payment has been made. Try the "contact us" button - you can fill in the spots but nothing sends. Called and the wait is 30 minutes. So, while waiting I thought I'd submit a few reviews. Feel free to buy a Toyota but DO NOT use TFS. They do not have their act together. Totally slipshod. If it weren't associated with the vehicle I would have posted this as a scam.

reviews.author: First
reviews.review_text: I leased a vehicle via Toyota Financial Services, all payments made on time and I had never even had the need to contact TFS over the 14 months I had been making payments on time. Then suddenly and unexpectedly I was laid off. I called TFS to see if it was possible to defer a payment or two until I had steady income coming in. TFS claimed that in order to defer a payment I would need to pay a $150 fee in advance. Im sorry but if a customer has made all payments on time and is proactive in seeking assistance rather than defaulting on all payments then I think it be advantageous to allow this fee to be included with the scheduled deferred payment. What genius executive came up with this needs to be terminated and hired at a debt collection firm where that sort of poor business acumen and ideology would be accepted. Absolutely ridiculous and it shows a customer where they stand and what little value they have. My suggestion is steer clear of Toyota Financial Services and Toyota as a whole seeing how they are part of Toyota. Toyota makes a great product but what's the incentive in purchasing if you are simply an account number and if and when a bad situation might occur you will be left out to dry like a red headed step child. I learned the hard way and will never even consider a Toyota product again.

reviews.author: Greg
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services was managing my Lexus Lease. I doubt many people will read this before deciding to lease a Lexus. All I can say is that they do not treat their clients well. They are a terrible company with egregious customer service. Lease another luxury car if you can.

reviews.author: Debbie
reviews.review_text: I have been a Toyota customer for years, with good experiences with the sales department. I just had a car accident (another driver ran a red light), and my 2020 Yaris (driven 450 km) was a total loss. I lease my cars from Toyota. I don’t drive many miles, and I trade my cars in after 4 years. My new monthly lease payment is always reduced by the equity on my trade-in. The equity reflected in my lease payments on the 2020 Yaris was $2200, though I’m sure Toyota profited more than this. Insurance paid Toyota the full replacement value of my 2020 Yaris, but Toyota is refusing to apply the equity which it enjoyed to my new lease payments, or to refund the equity.

reviews.author: Joshua
reviews.review_text: Me and my wife bought a new Toyota in June 2019. We got it financed through Toyota Financial. Never had a problem until July, August and September of 2020. I got a email about my credit report that said that Toyota reported that I was 30 days late on my payment for each of the last 3 months. I sent them proof from my Toyota account that showed every month was paid on time (even tho they can see that) and I sent proof from my bank that showed it. I asked them if they could remove those from my credit report since I showed plenty of proof that it was paid on time. They denied it and said nothing they could do. So now I have 3 remarks on my credit report that dropped my score over 50 points. I’ll probably just refinance my loan somewhere else even if I do have to pay more a month.

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.review_text: My family and I have driven Toyotas our entire lives. The cars are great but Toyota Financial's customer service center is so very horrific (and in every possible way) that I will not buy another Toyota again. That is how frustrated I am. The customer care people don't know what they're talking about. Their automated service is horrific. And there's no one you can write to. They supposedly have an email service, and you write and wait for them to write you back and guess what? An automatic generated message is delivered that basically tells you to call. The call center gave me the wrong information! This is utter disrespect for your customers, to not have a means of helping them! All I want to do is make an international payment and no one can help me. It's utterly infuriating. I'm calling long distance and it takes me forever to get through and one false move they cut you off and you have to start all over again. And when you get someone they give you the wrong information. I've always had a hard time with their service but this time, I AM DONE. And there's no one you can write to. You just lost a life time customer Toyota. All because you don't care about the quality of the customer service you're giving me.

reviews.author: Edward
reviews.review_text: Returned a 2014 RAV4 and forgot to include the cargo cover. Called 2 days later asking to return it, denied the request. Receive an invoice in the mail stating it would be $500 to replace the part. Upon inspection on the Toyota parts website, the MSRP on the part is $130 which we would have been happy to pay. Phone rep lied to us, stating that the price of $130 is if you want an extra cargo cover, but the initial part cost them $500. If they bought one to replace the missing one after we turned it in, it would have cost them $130. They said they would review and get back to us. It's now been 4 months of not hearing from them and today we get a call that we still owe $500. Not happening and we're not paying. Reporting this to the BBB. Do not consider Toyota for your lease options.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.review_text: Be careful of late payments! They have no remorse in coming to take their vehicle away from your driveway while you sleep during a Global Pandemic!!! Score another point for big corporations and another negative for the average person during all this BS!

reviews.author: Haley
reviews.review_text: Zero stars if I could. Worst experience. They misguided me multiple times in the process of getting a lien-release on a vehicle from a prior owner which delayed the process of my issue being resolved, they refused my calls, and refused to let me speak to managers to escalate the urgent matter.

reviews.author: Mirza
reviews.review_text: Toyota Financial Services are a bunch of crooks. I had requested an extension on an over mileage payment after my lease ended due to COVID and certain financial constraints.
